### Manipulating data and plotting positive betas only
  # i.e., if beta ku/kuf = neg. value, multiply beta ku/kuf and beta other sumstat by -1

```{r}

#install.packages("ggplot2")

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(deming)


# Fit generalized Deming regression using the standard errors
# of both beta estimates. This accounts for uncertainty on both axes.
get_deming_results <- function(
  plot_dat,
  x_beta,
  y_beta,
  x_se,
  y_se
) {

  deming_dat <- data.frame(
    x = as.numeric(plot_dat[[x_beta]]),
    y = as.numeric(plot_dat[[y_beta]]),
    x_se = as.numeric(plot_dat[[x_se]]),
    y_se = as.numeric(plot_dat[[y_se]])
  )

  deming_dat <- deming_dat[
    complete.cases(deming_dat) &
      is.finite(deming_dat$x) &
      is.finite(deming_dat$y) &
      is.finite(deming_dat$x_se) &
      is.finite(deming_dat$y_se) &
      deming_dat$x_se > 0 &
      deming_dat$y_se > 0,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (
    nrow(deming_dat) < 3 ||
      length(unique(deming_dat$x)) < 2 ||
      length(unique(deming_dat$y)) < 2
  ) {

    return(
      list(
        intercept = NA_real_,
        slope = NA_real_,
        slope_se = NA_real_,
        slope_p = NA_real_,
        label = "Deming regression not calculated"
      )
    )
  }

  deming_fit <- tryCatch(
    deming::deming(
      y ~ x,
      data = deming_dat,
      xstd = x_se,
      ystd = y_se,
      jackknife = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(deming_fit)) {

    return(
      list(
        intercept = NA_real_,
        slope = NA_real_,
        slope_se = NA_real_,
        slope_p = NA_real_,
        label = "Deming regression not calculated"
      )
    )
  }

  deming_coef <- coef(deming_fit)

  if (
    length(deming_coef) < 2 ||
      !all(is.finite(deming_coef[1:2]))
  ) {

    return(
      list(
        intercept = NA_real_,
        slope = NA_real_,
        slope_se = NA_real_,
        slope_p = NA_real_,
        label = "Deming regression not calculated"
      )
    )
  }

  deming_intercept <- unname(deming_coef[1])
  deming_slope <- unname(deming_coef[2])

  # deming$variance is the jackknife variance-covariance matrix.
  # The p-value below tests H0: Deming slope = 0 using a two-sided
  # normal approximation.
  deming_slope_se <- tryCatch(
    sqrt(deming_fit$variance[2, 2]),
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )

  deming_slope_p <- if (
    is.finite(deming_slope_se) && deming_slope_se > 0
  ) {
    2 * pnorm(
      abs(deming_slope / deming_slope_se),
      lower.tail = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  deming_p_label <- if (is.finite(deming_slope_p)) {
    paste0(
      " | Deming p = ",
      format.pval(
        deming_slope_p,
        digits = 3,
        eps = 1e-300
      )
    )
  } else {
    " | Deming p not calculated"
  }

  list(
    intercept = deming_intercept,
    slope = deming_slope,
    slope_se = deming_slope_se,
    slope_p = deming_slope_p,
    label = paste0(
      "Deming slope = ",
      formatC(
        deming_slope,
        format = "f",
        digits = 4
      ),
      deming_p_label
    )
  )
}

# Store one summary-table row for each plotted comparison
comparison_summary <- data.frame(
  `Khat Use or Khat Use Frequency` = character(),
  `Summary Statistic of Comparison` = character(),
  `Pearson Correlation` = numeric(),
  `Pearson Pvalue` = numeric(),
  `Deming Slope` = numeric(),
  `Deming Pvalue` = numeric(),
  `Number of Variants in Comparison` = integer(),
  `Number of Vars from Khat Use or Khat Use Frequency with pvalue < 0.05` = integer(),
  check.names = FALSE
)

add_comparison_summary <- function(
  plot_dat,
  x_beta,
  y_beta,
  x_p,
  khat_trait,
  comparison_label,
  deming_results
) {

  pearson_r_table <- NA_real_
  pearson_p_table <- NA_real_

  if (
    nrow(plot_dat) >= 3 &&
      length(unique(plot_dat[[x_beta]])) >= 2 &&
      length(unique(plot_dat[[y_beta]])) >= 2
  ) {

    pearson_test_table <- tryCatch(
      cor.test(
        plot_dat[[x_beta]],
        plot_dat[[y_beta]],
        method = "pearson"
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (!is.null(pearson_test_table)) {
      pearson_r_table <- unname(pearson_test_table$estimate)
      pearson_p_table <- pearson_test_table$p.value
    }
  }

  khat_p05_table <- sum(
    !is.na(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
      is.finite(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
      plot_dat[[x_p]] < 0.05
  )

  new_row <- data.frame(
    `Khat Use or Khat Use Frequency` = khat_trait,
    `Summary Statistic of Comparison` = comparison_label,
    `Pearson Correlation` = pearson_r_table,
    `Pearson Pvalue` = pearson_p_table,
    `Deming Slope` = deming_results$slope,
    `Deming Pvalue` = deming_results$slope_p,
    `Number of Variants in Comparison` = nrow(plot_dat),
    `Number of Vars from Khat Use or Khat Use Frequency with pvalue < 0.05` = khat_p05_table,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  comparison_summary <<- dplyr::bind_rows(
    comparison_summary,
    new_row
  )
}

```

```{r}
hatoum_lead <- c(
  "rs1937455", "rs1475064", "rs2860846", "rs1260326", "rs570436", "rs2717054", "rs55855024", "rs6795772",
  "rs3114045", "rs1662031", "rs1813006", "rs864882", "rs7073987", "rs2861190", "rs17602038", "rs6589386",
```

```{r}
# Hatoum: Store the lead-variant datasets here
hatoum_lead_data <- list()


for (file in files) {

  cat("\nProcessing:", basename(file), "\n")

  dat <- read.table(
    file,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    fill = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )


  # Identify required columns
  x_beta <- grep(
    "^beta_ku$|^beta_kuf$",
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE
  )

  y_beta <- grep(
    "^beta_Hatoum2023AddictionEuropean.*_to_khat_A1$",
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE
  )

  x_p <- grep(
    "^p_ku$|^p_kuf$",
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE
  )

  y_p <- "P"


  cat("x_beta:", x_beta, "\n")
  cat("y_beta:", y_beta, "\n")
  cat("x_p:", x_p, "\n")
  cat("y_p:", y_p, "\n")


  if (
    length(x_beta) != 1 ||
      length(y_beta) != 1 ||
      length(x_p) != 1 ||
      !(y_p %in% names(dat)) ||
      !("khat_marker" %in% names(dat))
  ) {

    cat(
      "Skipping because required columns were not found.\n"
    )

    print(names(dat))
    next
  }


  # Identify separate Hatoum marker column
  marker_candidates <- grep(
    "marker$|^SNP$|^rsid$|^RSID$",
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  marker_candidates <- setdiff(
    marker_candidates,
    "khat_marker"
  )

  if (length(marker_candidates) > 0) {

    hatoum_marker <- marker_candidates[1]

    cat(
      "Hatoum marker column:",
      hatoum_marker,
      "\n"
    )

  } else {

    hatoum_marker <- NULL

    cat(
      "No separate Hatoum marker column detected; ",
      "using khat_marker only.\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  }


  # Retain only requested Hatoum lead variants
  if (!is.null(hatoum_marker)) {

    dat_lead <- dat[
      dat$khat_marker %in% hatoum_lead |
        dat[[hatoum_marker]] %in% hatoum_lead,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

  } else {

    dat_lead <- dat[
      dat$khat_marker %in% hatoum_lead,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  }


  cat(
    "Lead SNP rows found:",
    nrow(dat_lead),
    "\n"
  )


  if (nrow(dat_lead) == 0) {

    cat(
      "No Hatoum lead variants found; skipping.\n"
    )

    next
  }


  # Convert beta and p-value columns to numeric
  dat_lead[[x_beta]] <- as.numeric(
    dat_lead[[x_beta]]
  )

  dat_lead[[y_beta]] <- as.numeric(
    dat_lead[[y_beta]]
  )

  dat_lead[[x_p]] <- as.numeric(
    dat_lead[[x_p]]
  )

  dat_lead[[y_p]] <- as.numeric(
    dat_lead[[y_p]]
  )


  # Reconstruct signed Z-scores from two-sided p-values
  #
  # Z = sign(beta) * |qnorm(p / 2)|
  dat_lead$z_khat <- ifelse(
    !is.na(dat_lead[[x_beta]]) &
      !is.na(dat_lead[[x_p]]) &
      dat_lead[[x_p]] > 0 &
      dat_lead[[x_p]] < 1 &
      dat_lead[[x_beta]] != 0,

    sign(dat_lead[[x_beta]]) *
      abs(qnorm(dat_lead[[x_p]] / 2)),

    NA_real_
  )

  dat_lead$z_hatoum <- ifelse(
    !is.na(dat_lead[[y_beta]]) &
      !is.na(dat_lead[[y_p]]) &
      dat_lead[[y_p]] > 0 &
      dat_lead[[y_p]] < 1 &
      dat_lead[[y_beta]] != 0,

    sign(dat_lead[[y_beta]]) *
      abs(qnorm(dat_lead[[y_p]] / 2)),

    NA_real_
  )


  # Reconstruct standard errors
  #
  # SE = beta / Z
  dat_lead$se_khat <- ifelse(
    !is.na(dat_lead$z_khat) &
      dat_lead$z_khat != 0,

    dat_lead[[x_beta]] /
      dat_lead$z_khat,

    NA_real_
  )

  dat_lead$se_hatoum <- ifelse(
    !is.na(dat_lead$z_hatoum) &
      dat_lead$z_hatoum != 0,

    dat_lead[[y_beta]] /
      dat_lead$z_hatoum,

    NA_real_
  )


  # Store column names for the plotting cell
  attr(dat_lead, "x_beta") <- x_beta
  attr(dat_lead, "y_beta") <- y_beta
  attr(dat_lead, "x_p") <- x_p
  attr(dat_lead, "y_p") <- y_p
  attr(dat_lead, "hatoum_marker") <- hatoum_marker


  # Name each list element using the input filename
  pair_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(
    basename(file)
  )

  hatoum_lead_data[[pair_name]] <- dat_lead


  cat(
    "Rows with reconstructed KU/KUF SE:",
    sum(!is.na(dat_lead$se_khat)),
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "Rows with reconstructed Hatoum SE:",
    sum(!is.na(dat_lead$se_hatoum)),
    "\n"
  )
}


# Inspect the resulting list
names(hatoum_lead_data)

lapply(
  hatoum_lead_data,
  function(x) {
    x[
      ,
      c(
        "khat_marker",
        attr(x, "x_beta"),
        attr(x, "x_p"),
        "z_khat",
        "se_khat",
        attr(x, "y_beta"),
        attr(x, "y_p"),
        "z_hatoum",
        "se_hatoum"
      )
    ]
  }
)
```

```{r}
# Hatoum: positive KU/KUF beta graphing

for (pair_name in names(hatoum_lead_data)) {

  cat("\nPlotting:", pair_name, "\n")

  plot_dat <- hatoum_lead_data[[pair_name]]


  # Retrieve column names stored in Cell 1
  x_beta <- attr(plot_dat, "x_beta")
  y_beta <- attr(plot_dat, "y_beta")
  x_p <- attr(plot_dat, "x_p")
  hatoum_marker <- attr(
    plot_dat,
    "hatoum_marker"
  )


  # Remove rows missing either beta or either SE
  plot_dat <- plot_dat[
    !is.na(plot_dat[[x_beta]]) &
      !is.na(plot_dat[[y_beta]]) &
      !is.na(plot_dat$se_khat) &
      !is.na(plot_dat$se_hatoum) &
      is.finite(plot_dat$se_khat) &
      is.finite(plot_dat$se_hatoum) &
      plot_dat$se_khat >= 0 &
      plot_dat$se_hatoum >= 0,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  if (nrow(plot_dat) == 0) {

    cat(
      "Skipping because no rows have complete beta and SE values.\n"
    )

    next
  }


  # Orient the KU/KUF beta positively
  #
  # Flip both aligned betas together.
  # Standard errors remain unchanged.
  flip_rows <- plot_dat[[x_beta]] < 0

  cat(
    "Lead SNP rows flipped:",
    sum(flip_rows),
    "\n"
  )

  plot_dat[[x_beta]][flip_rows] <-
    -plot_dat[[x_beta]][flip_rows]

  plot_dat[[y_beta]][flip_rows] <-
    -plot_dat[[y_beta]][flip_rows]


  # Calculate 95% confidence intervals
  plot_dat$x_ci_lower <-
    plot_dat[[x_beta]] -
    1.96 * plot_dat$se_khat

  plot_dat$x_ci_upper <-
    plot_dat[[x_beta]] +
    1.96 * plot_dat$se_khat

  plot_dat$y_ci_lower <-
    plot_dat[[y_beta]] -
    1.96 * plot_dat$se_hatoum

  plot_dat$y_ci_upper <-
    plot_dat[[y_beta]] +
    1.96 * plot_dat$se_hatoum


  # Highlight when KU/KUF p < 1e-5
  plot_dat$highlight <-
    !is.na(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
    plot_dat[[x_p]] < ku_sug_thresh


  # Create marker labels
  if (
    !is.null(hatoum_marker) &&
      hatoum_marker %in% names(plot_dat)
  ) {

    plot_dat$plot_marker <- ifelse(
      !is.na(plot_dat[[hatoum_marker]]) &
        plot_dat[[hatoum_marker]] != "",
      plot_dat[[hatoum_marker]],
      plot_dat$khat_marker
    )

  } else {

    plot_dat$plot_marker <-
      plot_dat$khat_marker
  }


  # Trait and sample-size labels
  if (grepl("^ku_", pair_name)) {

    khat_trait <- "Khat Use"
    khat_n_label <- "KU N = 33,210"

  } else {

    khat_trait <- "Khat Use Frequency"
    khat_n_label <- "KUF N = 25,869"
  }

  hatoum_label <- "Hatoum Addiction European"
  sud_n_label <- "SUD N = 1,025,550"



  # Count plotted variants with nominal KU/KUF association (P < 0.05)
  khat_p05_count <- sum(
    !is.na(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
      is.finite(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
      plot_dat[[x_p]] < 0.05
  )

  cat(
    khat_trait,
    " variants with P < 0.05:",
    khat_p05_count,
    "\n"
  )

  # Pearson correlation
  if (
    nrow(plot_dat) >= 3 &&
      length(unique(plot_dat[[x_beta]])) >= 2 &&
      length(unique(plot_dat[[y_beta]])) >= 2
  ) {

    pearson_test <- cor.test(
      plot_dat[[x_beta]],
      plot_dat[[y_beta]],
      method = "pearson"
    )

    pearson_r <- unname(
      pearson_test$estimate
    )

    pearson_p <- pearson_test$p.value

    title_correlation <- paste0(
      " | r = ",
      round(pearson_r, 4)
    )

    correlation_label <- paste0(
      "Pearson p = ",
      format.pval(
        pearson_p,
        digits = 3,
        eps = 1e-300
      )
    )

  } else {

    title_correlation <- ""

    correlation_label <- paste0(
      "Pearson correlation not calculated; ",
      nrow(plot_dat),
      " complete lead SNP",
      ifelse(
        nrow(plot_dat) == 1,
        "",
        "s"
      ),
      " available"
    )
  }


  # Plot
  # Generalized Deming regression
  deming_results <- get_deming_results(
    plot_dat = plot_dat,
    x_beta = x_beta,
    y_beta = y_beta,
    x_se = "se_khat",
    y_se = "se_hatoum"
  )

  add_comparison_summary(
    plot_dat = plot_dat,
    x_beta = x_beta,
    y_beta = y_beta,
    x_p = x_p,
    khat_trait = khat_trait,
    comparison_label = hatoum_label,
    deming_results = deming_results
  )


  p <- ggplot(
    plot_dat,
    aes(
      x = .data[[x_beta]],
      y = .data[[y_beta]]
    )
  ) +

    # Horizontal 95% CIs for KU/KUF beta
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        xmin = x_ci_lower,
        xmax = x_ci_upper
      ),
      orientation = "y",
      width = 0,
      alpha = 0.4,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    # Vertical 95% CIs for Hatoum beta
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = y_ci_lower,
        ymax = y_ci_upper
      ),
      width = 0,
      alpha = 0.4,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    # Plot every available Hatoum lead SNP
    geom_point(
      alpha = 0.6,
      size = 3
    ) +

    # Ordinary least-squares line of best fit
    {
      if (
        nrow(plot_dat) >= 2 &&
          length(unique(plot_dat[[x_beta]])) >= 2
      ) {

        geom_smooth(
          method = "lm",
          formula = y ~ x,
          se = FALSE,
          color = "blue",
          linetype = "dashed",
          linewidth = 0.8
        )
      }
    } +

    # Generalized Deming regression line
    {
      if (
        is.finite(deming_results$intercept) &&
          is.finite(deming_results$slope)
      ) {

        geom_abline(
          intercept = deming_results$intercept,
          slope = deming_results$slope,
          color = "blue",
          linetype = "solid",
          linewidth = 0.8
        )
      }
    } +

    # Highlight SNPs with KU/KUF p < 1e-5
    geom_point(
      data = subset(
        plot_dat,
        highlight
      ),
      color = "red",
      size = 3.5
    ) +

    # Label highlighted SNPs
    geom_text_repel(
      data = subset(
        plot_dat,
        highlight
      ),
      aes(
        label = plot_marker
      ),
      color = "red",
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.3,
      point.padding = 0.2
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0
    ) +

    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0
    ) +

    theme_bw() +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 10
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 6
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "NGAP: ",
        khat_trait,
        " x ",
        hatoum_label,
        " Lead SNPs",
        title_correlation
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        khat_n_label,
        " | ",
        sud_n_label,
        " | Lead SNPs plotted = ",
        nrow(plot_dat),
        " | Error bars = reconstructed 95% CIs",
        " | ",
        deming_results$label,
        " | ",
        correlation_label
      ),
      x = paste0(
        khat_trait,
        " beta"
      ),
      y = "Hatoum Addiction beta"
    )

  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
# Johnson: setup, subset to lead SNPs, and calculate KU/KUF SE

data_dir <- "/Users/nico/work/sud/johnson_lifted_harmonized"

ku_sug_thresh <- 1e-5

files <- list.files(
  path = data_dir,
  pattern = paste0(
    "^(ku|kuf)_CUD_EUR_casecontrol_public_",
    "11\\.14\\.2020_harmonized\\.txt$"
  ),
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Johnson genome-wide significant lead variants
johnson_lead <- c(
  "rs7783012",
  "rs4732724"
)

cat("Files found:", length(files), "\n")
print(basename(files))


# Store lead-SNP datasets for plotting in Cell 2
johnson_lead_data <- list()


for (file in files) {

  cat("\nProcessing:", basename(file), "\n")

  is_ku <- grepl(
    "^ku_",
    basename(file)
  )

  if (is_ku) {

    khat_beta <- "beta_ku"
    khat_p <- "p_ku"

  } else {

    khat_beta <- "beta_kuf"
    khat_p <- "p_kuf"
  }


  dat <- read.table(
    file,
    header = FALSE,
    sep = "\t",
    skip = 1,
    fill = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    col.names = c(
      "khat_marker",
      "CHR",
      "BP",
      "khat_A1",
      "khat_A2",
      khat_beta,
      khat_p,
      "johnson_marker",
      "johnson_A1",
      "johnson_A2",
      "beta_CUD_EUR_casecontrol",
      "beta_CUD_EUR_casecontrol_to_khat_A1",
      "P",
      "allele_match_status",
      "SE",
      "N",
      "N_CAS",
      "N_CON"
    )
  )


  # Keep only the requested Johnson lead SNPs
  dat_lead <- dat[
    dat$khat_marker %in% johnson_lead |
      dat$johnson_marker %in% johnson_lead,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  cat(
    "Requested Johnson lead SNPs:",
    length(johnson_lead),
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "Lead SNP rows found:",
    nrow(dat_lead),
    "\n"
  )


  # Determine which lead SNPs were found
  found_leads <- unique(
    c(
      dat_lead$khat_marker[
        dat_lead$khat_marker %in% johnson_lead
      ],
      dat_lead$johnson_marker[
        dat_lead$johnson_marker %in% johnson_lead
      ]
    )
  )

  found_leads <- found_leads[
    !is.na(found_leads) &
      found_leads != ""
  ]

  missing_leads <- setdiff(
    johnson_lead,
    found_leads
  )

  cat(
    "Lead SNPs found:",
    if (length(found_leads) > 0) {
      paste(found_leads, collapse = ", ")
    } else {
      "none"
    },
    "\n"
  )

  if (length(missing_leads) > 0) {

    cat(
      "Lead SNPs missing:",
      paste(missing_leads, collapse = ", "),
      "\n"
    )
  }


  if (nrow(dat_lead) == 0) {

    cat(
      "No Johnson lead SNPs found; skipping.\n"
    )

    next
  }


  # Convert required columns to numeric
  dat_lead[[khat_beta]] <- as.numeric(
    dat_lead[[khat_beta]]
  )

  dat_lead[[khat_p]] <- as.numeric(
    dat_lead[[khat_p]]
  )

  dat_lead$beta_CUD_EUR_casecontrol_to_khat_A1 <-
    as.numeric(
      dat_lead$beta_CUD_EUR_casecontrol_to_khat_A1
    )

  dat_lead$P <- as.numeric(
    dat_lead$P
  )

  # Johnson SE is already included in the input file
  dat_lead$SE <- as.numeric(
    dat_lead$SE
  )


  # Reconstruct signed KU/KUF Z-score from the two-sided p-value
  #
  # Z = sign(beta) * |Phi^(-1)(p / 2)|
  dat_lead$z_khat <- ifelse(
    !is.na(dat_lead[[khat_beta]]) &
      is.finite(dat_lead[[khat_beta]]) &
      !is.na(dat_lead[[khat_p]]) &
      is.finite(dat_lead[[khat_p]]) &
      dat_lead[[khat_p]] > 0 &
      dat_lead[[khat_p]] < 1 &
      dat_lead[[khat_beta]] != 0,

    sign(dat_lead[[khat_beta]]) *
      abs(qnorm(dat_lead[[khat_p]] / 2)),

    NA_real_
  )


  # Reconstruct KU/KUF standard error
  #
  # SE = beta / Z
  dat_lead$se_khat <- ifelse(
    !is.na(dat_lead$z_khat) &
      is.finite(dat_lead$z_khat) &
      dat_lead$z_khat != 0,

    dat_lead[[khat_beta]] /
      dat_lead$z_khat,

    NA_real_
  )


  # Give the reported Johnson SE a clearer name
  dat_lead$se_johnson <- dat_lead$SE


  # Store information needed by Cell 2
  attr(dat_lead, "x_beta") <- khat_beta
  attr(dat_lead, "x_p") <- khat_p


  pair_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(
    basename(file)
  )

  johnson_lead_data[[pair_name]] <- dat_lead


  cat(
    "Rows with reconstructed KU/KUF SE:",
    sum(
      !is.na(dat_lead$se_khat) &
        is.finite(dat_lead$se_khat)
    ),
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "Rows with reported Johnson SE:",
    sum(
      !is.na(dat_lead$se_johnson) &
        is.finite(dat_lead$se_johnson)
    ),
    "\n"
  )
}


# Inspect stored datasets
names(johnson_lead_data)

lapply(
  johnson_lead_data,
  function(dat) {

    x_beta <- attr(dat, "x_beta")
    x_p <- attr(dat, "x_p")

    dat[
      ,
      c(
        "khat_marker",
        "johnson_marker",
        x_beta,
        x_p,
        "z_khat",
        "se_khat",
        "beta_CUD_EUR_casecontrol_to_khat_A1",
        "P",
        "se_johnson"
      ),
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  }
)
```

```{r}
# Johnson: KU/KUF lead SNP comparison plots
# Horizontal error bars: reconstructed KU/KUF 95% CI
# Vertical error bars: reported Johnson 95% CI


for (pair_name in names(johnson_lead_data)) {

  cat("\nPlotting:", pair_name, "\n")

  plot_dat <- johnson_lead_data[[pair_name]]

  x_beta <- attr(
    plot_dat,
    "x_beta"
  )

  x_p <- attr(
    plot_dat,
    "x_p"
  )

  y_beta <- "beta_CUD_EUR_casecontrol_to_khat_A1"


  # Set plot labels
  if (grepl("^ku_", pair_name)) {

    khat_trait <- "Khat Use"
    khat_n_label <- "KU N = 33,210"

  } else {

    khat_trait <- "Khat Use Frequency"
    khat_n_label <- "KUF N = 25,869"
  }


  # Retain rows with complete beta and SE values
  plot_dat <- plot_dat[
    !is.na(plot_dat[[x_beta]]) &
      !is.na(plot_dat[[y_beta]]) &
      !is.na(plot_dat$se_khat) &
      !is.na(plot_dat$se_johnson) &
      is.finite(plot_dat$se_khat) &
      is.finite(plot_dat$se_johnson) &
      plot_dat$se_khat >= 0 &
      plot_dat$se_johnson >= 0,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  cat(
    "Complete lead SNPs available:",
    nrow(plot_dat),
    "\n"
  )


  if (nrow(plot_dat) == 0) {

    cat(
      "Skipping plot because no complete Johnson lead SNPs were found.\n"
    )

    next
  }


  # Orient KU/KUF beta positively
  #
  # Flip both aligned beta estimates together.
  # Standard errors do not change.
  flip_rows <- plot_dat[[x_beta]] < 0

  cat(
    "Lead SNPs flipped:",
    sum(flip_rows),
    "\n"
  )

  plot_dat[[x_beta]][flip_rows] <-
    -plot_dat[[x_beta]][flip_rows]

  plot_dat[[y_beta]][flip_rows] <-
    -plot_dat[[y_beta]][flip_rows]


  # Calculate 95% confidence intervals
  plot_dat$x_ci_lower <-
    plot_dat[[x_beta]] -
    1.96 * plot_dat$se_khat

  plot_dat$x_ci_upper <-
    plot_dat[[x_beta]] +
    1.96 * plot_dat$se_khat

  plot_dat$y_ci_lower <-
    plot_dat[[y_beta]] -
    1.96 * plot_dat$se_johnson

  plot_dat$y_ci_upper <-
    plot_dat[[y_beta]] +
    1.96 * plot_dat$se_johnson


  # Highlight only SNPs with KU/KUF p < 1e-5
  plot_dat$highlight <-
    !is.na(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
      plot_dat[[x_p]] < ku_sug_thresh


  cat(
    "Lead SNPs highlighted at KU/KUF P < ",
    ku_sug_thresh,
    ": ",
    sum(plot_dat$highlight),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  # Use Johnson marker for labels when available
  plot_dat$plot_marker <- ifelse(
    !is.na(plot_dat$johnson_marker) &
      plot_dat$johnson_marker != "",
    plot_dat$johnson_marker,
    plot_dat$khat_marker
  )



  # Count plotted variants with nominal KU/KUF association (P < 0.05)
  khat_p05_count <- sum(
    !is.na(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
      is.finite(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
      plot_dat[[x_p]] < 0.05
  )

  cat(
    khat_trait,
    " variants with P < 0.05:",
    khat_p05_count,
    "\n"
  )

  # Pearson correlation
  #
  # Johnson has only two requested lead SNPs, so Pearson
  # correlation will generally not be calculated.
  if (
    nrow(plot_dat) >= 3 &&
      length(unique(plot_dat[[x_beta]])) >= 2 &&
      length(unique(plot_dat[[y_beta]])) >= 2
  ) {

    pearson_test <- cor.test(
      plot_dat[[x_beta]],
      plot_dat[[y_beta]],
      method = "pearson"
    )

    pearson_r <- unname(
      pearson_test$estimate
    )

    pearson_p <- pearson_test$p.value

    title_correlation <- paste0(
      " | r = ",
      round(pearson_r, 4)
    )

    correlation_label <- paste0(
      "Pearson p = ",
      format.pval(
        pearson_p,
        digits = 3,
        eps = 1e-300
      )
    )

  } else {

    title_correlation <- ""

    correlation_label <- paste0(
      "Pearson correlation not calculated; ",
      nrow(plot_dat),
      " complete lead SNP",
      ifelse(
        nrow(plot_dat) == 1,
        "",
        "s"
      ),
      " available"
    )
  }


  # Generalized Deming regression
  deming_results <- get_deming_results(
    plot_dat = plot_dat,
    x_beta = x_beta,
    y_beta = y_beta,
    x_se = "se_khat",
    y_se = "se_johnson"
  )

  add_comparison_summary(
    plot_dat = plot_dat,
    x_beta = x_beta,
    y_beta = y_beta,
    x_p = x_p,
    khat_trait = khat_trait,
    comparison_label = "Johnson CUD European Case-Control",
    deming_results = deming_results
  )


  p <- ggplot(
    plot_dat,
    aes(
      x = .data[[x_beta]],
      y = .data[[y_beta]]
    )
  ) +

    # Horizontal KU/KUF 95% confidence intervals
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        xmin = x_ci_lower,
        xmax = x_ci_upper
      ),
      orientation = "y",
      width = 0,
      alpha = 0.4,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    # Vertical Johnson 95% confidence intervals
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = y_ci_lower,
        ymax = y_ci_upper
      ),
      width = 0,
      alpha = 0.4,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    # Plot every available Johnson lead SNP
    geom_point(
      alpha = 0.6,
      size = 3
    ) +

    # Ordinary least-squares line of best fit
    {
      if (
        nrow(plot_dat) >= 2 &&
          length(unique(plot_dat[[x_beta]])) >= 2
      ) {

        geom_smooth(
          method = "lm",
          formula = y ~ x,
          se = FALSE,
          color = "blue",
          linetype = "dashed",
          linewidth = 0.8
        )
      }
    } +

    # Generalized Deming regression line
    {
      if (
        is.finite(deming_results$intercept) &&
          is.finite(deming_results$slope)
      ) {

        geom_abline(
          intercept = deming_results$intercept,
          slope = deming_results$slope,
          color = "blue",
          linetype = "solid",
          linewidth = 0.8
        )
      }
    } +

    # Highlight SNPs with KU/KUF p < 1e-5
    geom_point(
      data = subset(
        plot_dat,
        highlight
      ),
      color = "red",
      size = 3.5
    ) +

    # Label highlighted SNPs
    geom_text_repel(
      data = subset(
        plot_dat,
        highlight
      ),
      aes(
        label = plot_marker
      ),
      color = "red",
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.3,
      point.padding = 0.2
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0
    ) +

    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0
    ) +

    theme_bw() +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 11
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 5.5
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "NGAP ",
        khat_trait,
        " x Johnson CUD European Case-Control Lead SNPs",
        title_correlation
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        khat_n_label,
        " | CUD N = 357,806",
        " | Lead SNPs plotted = ",
        nrow(plot_dat),
        " | Error bars = 95% CIs",
        " | ",
        deming_results$label,
        " | ",
        correlation_label
      ),
      x = paste0(
        khat_trait,
        " beta"
      ),
      y = "Johnson CUD beta"
    )

  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
# Levey: subset to lead SNPs and prepare SEs

data_dir <- "/Users/nico/work/sud/levey_lifted_harmonized"

ku_sug_thresh <- 1e-5

files <- list.files(
  path = data_dir,
  pattern = "^(ku|kuf)_(AFR|EUR)_harmonized\\.txt$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

levey_lead <- c(
  "rs7519259",
  "rs6690119",
  "rs1526480",
  "rs719504",
  "rs184064410",
  "rs3774800",
  "rs17007864",
  "rs726610",
  "rs201175241",
  "rs56070621",
  "rs159365",
  "rs9344740",
  "rs62461183",
  "rs2189010",
  "rs545943750",
  "rs56372821",
  "rs10986600",
  "rs200595759",
  "rs6484345",
  "rs34554234",
  "rs80030908",
  "rs62051488"
)

cat("Number of files found:", length(files), "\n")
print(basename(files))


levey_lead_data <- list()


for (file in files) {

  cat("\nProcessing:", basename(file), "\n")

  dat <- read.table(
    file,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    fill = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  x_beta <- grep(
    "^beta_ku$|^beta_kuf$",
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE
  )

  x_p <- grep(
    "^p_ku$|^p_kuf$",
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE
  )

  y_beta <- grep(
    "_to_khat_A1$",
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE
  )

  # Search for Levey p-value column
  y_p_candidates <- grep(
    "^P$|^p$|pval|p_value|pvalue",
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  # Exclude KU/KUF p-value column
  y_p_candidates <- setdiff(
    y_p_candidates,
    x_p
  )

  # Search for an original Levey SE column
  y_se_candidates <- grep(
    "^SE$|stderr|std_err|standard_error|^se_",
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  # Exclude possible KU/KUF SE columns
  y_se_candidates <- y_se_candidates[
    !grepl(
      "ku|kuf",
      y_se_candidates,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ]

  cat("x_beta:", paste(x_beta, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("x_p:", paste(x_p, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("y_beta:", paste(y_beta, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat(
    "Levey p candidates:",
    paste(y_p_candidates, collapse = ", "),
    "\n"
  )
  cat(
    "Levey SE candidates:",
    paste(y_se_candidates, collapse = ", "),
    "\n"
  )

  if (
    length(x_beta) != 1 ||
      length(x_p) != 1 ||
      length(y_beta) != 1 ||
      !("khat_marker" %in% names(dat))
  ) {

    cat(
      "Skipping because required beta, p-value, or marker columns were not identified.\n"
    )

    print(names(dat))
    next
  }


  # Select Levey p-value if exactly one candidate exists
  if (length(y_p_candidates) == 1) {

    y_p <- y_p_candidates

  } else {

    y_p <- NULL
  }


  # Select original Levey SE if exactly one candidate exists
  if (length(y_se_candidates) == 1) {

    y_se <- y_se_candidates

  } else {

    y_se <- NULL
  }


  # Identify Levey marker column
  if ("levey_marker" %in% names(dat)) {

    levey_marker <- "levey_marker"

  } else {

    marker_candidates <- grep(
      "marker$|^SNP$|^rsid$",
      names(dat),
      value = TRUE,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )

    marker_candidates <- setdiff(
      marker_candidates,
      "khat_marker"
    )

    if (length(marker_candidates) > 0) {

      levey_marker <- marker_candidates[1]

    } else {

      levey_marker <- NULL
    }
  }


  # Keep only requested lead SNPs
  if (!is.null(levey_marker)) {

    dat_lead <- dat[
      dat$khat_marker %in% levey_lead |
        dat[[levey_marker]] %in% levey_lead,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

  } else {

    dat_lead <- dat[
      dat$khat_marker %in% levey_lead,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  }


  cat("Lead SNP rows found:", nrow(dat_lead), "\n")


  if (nrow(dat_lead) == 0) {

    cat("No requested lead SNPs found; skipping.\n")
    next
  }


  # Convert required values to numeric
  dat_lead[[x_beta]] <- as.numeric(
    dat_lead[[x_beta]]
  )

  dat_lead[[x_p]] <- as.numeric(
    dat_lead[[x_p]]
  )

  dat_lead[[y_beta]] <- as.numeric(
    dat_lead[[y_beta]]
  )


  # Reconstruct signed KU/KUF Z-score and standard error
  #
  # Z  = sign(beta) * |Phi^(-1)(p / 2)|
  # SE = beta / Z
  dat_lead$z_khat <- ifelse(
    !is.na(dat_lead[[x_beta]]) &
      is.finite(dat_lead[[x_beta]]) &
      !is.na(dat_lead[[x_p]]) &
      is.finite(dat_lead[[x_p]]) &
      dat_lead[[x_p]] > 0 &
      dat_lead[[x_p]] < 1 &
      dat_lead[[x_beta]] != 0,

    sign(dat_lead[[x_beta]]) *
      abs(qnorm(dat_lead[[x_p]] / 2)),

    NA_real_
  )

  dat_lead$se_khat <- ifelse(
    !is.na(dat_lead$z_khat) &
      is.finite(dat_lead$z_khat) &
      dat_lead$z_khat != 0,

    dat_lead[[x_beta]] /
      dat_lead$z_khat,

    NA_real_
  )


  # Use original Levey SE when available
  if (!is.null(y_se)) {

    dat_lead[[y_se]] <- as.numeric(
      dat_lead[[y_se]]
    )

    dat_lead$se_levey <- dat_lead[[y_se]]

    cat(
      "Using reported Levey SE column:",
      y_se,
      "\n"
    )

  } else if (!is.null(y_p)) {

    # Otherwise reconstruct Levey SE from beta and p-value
    dat_lead[[y_p]] <- as.numeric(
      dat_lead[[y_p]]
    )

    dat_lead$z_levey <- ifelse(
      !is.na(dat_lead[[y_beta]]) &
        is.finite(dat_lead[[y_beta]]) &
        !is.na(dat_lead[[y_p]]) &
        is.finite(dat_lead[[y_p]]) &
        dat_lead[[y_p]] > 0 &
        dat_lead[[y_p]] < 1 &
        dat_lead[[y_beta]] != 0,

      sign(dat_lead[[y_beta]]) *
        abs(qnorm(dat_lead[[y_p]] / 2)),

      NA_real_
    )

    dat_lead$se_levey <- ifelse(
      !is.na(dat_lead$z_levey) &
        is.finite(dat_lead$z_levey) &
        dat_lead$z_levey != 0,

      dat_lead[[y_beta]] /
        dat_lead$z_levey,

      NA_real_
    )

    cat(
      "Reconstructed Levey SE using p-value column:",
      y_p,
      "\n"
    )

  } else {

    dat_lead$se_levey <- NA_real_

    cat(
      "No Levey SE or p-value column was identified.\n"
    )
  }


  attr(dat_lead, "x_beta") <- x_beta
  attr(dat_lead, "x_p") <- x_p
  attr(dat_lead, "y_beta") <- y_beta
  attr(dat_lead, "levey_marker") <- levey_marker


  pair_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(
    basename(file)
  )

  levey_lead_data[[pair_name]] <- dat_lead


  cat(
    "Dataset saved:",
    pair_name,
    "| rows =",
    nrow(dat_lead),
    "| complete KU/KUF SE =",
    sum(
      is.finite(dat_lead$se_khat),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    "| complete Levey SE =",
    sum(
      is.finite(dat_lead$se_levey),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    "\n"
  )
}


cat(
  "\nDatasets prepared:",
  length(levey_lead_data),
  "\n"
)

print(names(levey_lead_data))
```

```{r}
    !is.na(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
      is.finite(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
      plot_dat[[x_p]] < 0.05
  )

  cat(
    khat_trait,
    " variants with P < 0.05:",
    khat_p05_count,
    "\n"
  )

  # Pearson correlation
  if (
    nrow(plot_dat) >= 3 &&
      length(unique(plot_dat[[x_beta]])) >= 2 &&
      length(unique(plot_dat[[y_beta]])) >= 2
  ) {

    pearson_test <- cor.test(
      plot_dat[[x_beta]],
      plot_dat[[y_beta]],
      method = "pearson"
    )

    title_correlation <- paste0(
      " | r = ",
      round(
        unname(pearson_test$estimate),
        4
      )
    )

    correlation_label <- paste0(
      "Pearson p = ",
      format.pval(
        pearson_test$p.value,
        digits = 3,
        eps = 1e-300
      )
    )

  } else {

    title_correlation <- ""

    correlation_label <- paste0(
      "Pearson correlation not calculated; ",
      nrow(plot_dat),
      " complete lead SNP",
      ifelse(
        nrow(plot_dat) == 1,
        "",
        "s"
      ),
      " available"
    )
  }


  # Generalized Deming regression
  deming_results <- get_deming_results(
    plot_dat = plot_dat,
    x_beta = x_beta,
    y_beta = y_beta,
    x_se = "se_khat",
    y_se = "se_levey"
  )

  add_comparison_summary(
    plot_dat = plot_dat,
    x_beta = x_beta,
    y_beta = y_beta,
    x_p = x_p,
    khat_trait = khat_trait,
    comparison_label = paste0("Levey ", ancestry_label, " CUD"),
    deming_results = deming_results
  )


  p <- ggplot(
    plot_dat,
    aes(
      x = .data[[x_beta]],
      y = .data[[y_beta]]
    )
  ) +

    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        xmin = x_ci_lower,
        xmax = x_ci_upper
      ),
      orientation = "y",
      width = 0,
      alpha = 0.4,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = y_ci_lower,
        ymax = y_ci_upper
      ),
      width = 0,
      alpha = 0.4,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    geom_point(
      alpha = 0.6,
      size = 3
    ) +

    # Ordinary least-squares line of best fit
    {
      if (
        nrow(plot_dat) >= 2 &&
          length(unique(plot_dat[[x_beta]])) >= 2
      ) {

        geom_smooth(
          method = "lm",
          formula = y ~ x,
          se = FALSE,
          color = "blue",
          linetype = "dashed",
          linewidth = 0.8
        )
      }
    } +

    # Generalized Deming regression line
    {
      if (
        is.finite(deming_results$intercept) &&
          is.finite(deming_results$slope)
      ) {

        geom_abline(
          intercept = deming_results$intercept,
          slope = deming_results$slope,
          color = "blue",
          linetype = "solid",
          linewidth = 0.8
        )
      }
    } +

    geom_point(
      data = subset(
        plot_dat,
        highlight
      ),
      color = "red",
      size = 3.5
    ) +

    geom_text_repel(
      data = subset(
        plot_dat,
        highlight
      ),
      aes(
        label = plot_marker
      ),
      color = "red",
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.3,
      point.padding = 0.2
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0
    ) +

    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0
    ) +

    theme_bw() +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 12
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 7
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "NGAP: ",
        khat_trait,
        " x Levey ",
        ancestry_label,
        " CUD Lead SNPs",
        title_correlation
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        khat_n_label,
        " | ",
        cud_n_label,
        " | Lead SNPs plotted = ",
        nrow(plot_dat),
        " | Error bars = 95% CIs",
        " | ",
        deming_results$label,
        " | ",
        correlation_label
      ),
      x = paste0(
        khat_trait,
        " beta"
      ),
      y = paste0(
        "Levey ",
        ancestry_label,
        " CUD beta"
      )
    )

  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
# Liu: subset to phenotype-specific lead SNPs and reconstruct SEs

data_dir <- "/Users/nico/work/sud/liu_lifted_harmonized"

ku_sug_thresh <- 1e-5

files <- list.files(
  path = data_dir,
  pattern = "^(ku|kuf)_.+_harmonized\\.txt$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

cat("Number of files found:", length(files), "\n")
print(basename(files))


# Store prepared lead-SNP datasets for the plotting cell
liu_lead_data <- list()


for (file in files) {

  cat("\nProcessing:", basename(file), "\n")

  dat <- read.table(
    file,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    fill = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )


  # Identify KU/KUF beta and p-value columns
  x_beta <- grep(
    "^beta_ku$|^beta_kuf$",
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE
  )

  x_p <- grep(
    "^p_ku$|^p_kuf$",
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE
  )


  # Identify the aligned Liu beta column
  y_beta <- grep(
    "_to_khat_A1$",
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE
  )


  # Identify the Liu p-value column.
  #
  # First prefer an exact column named P.
  # Otherwise search for a non-KU/KUF p-value column.
  if ("P" %in% names(dat)) {

    y_p <- "P"

  } else {

    y_p_candidates <- grep(
      "^p$|pval|p_value|pvalue",
      names(dat),
      value = TRUE,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )

    y_p_candidates <- setdiff(
      y_p_candidates,
      x_p
    )

    if (length(y_p_candidates) == 1) {

      y_p <- y_p_candidates

    } else {

      y_p <- character(0)
    }
  }


  # Look for an original Liu SE column
  y_se_candidates <- grep(
    "^SE$|^se$|stderr|std_err|standard_error",
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  y_se_candidates <- y_se_candidates[
    !grepl(
      "ku|kuf|khat",
      y_se_candidates,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ]


  cat("x_beta:", paste(x_beta, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("x_p:", paste(x_p, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("y_beta:", paste(y_beta, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("y_p:", paste(y_p, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat(
    "Liu SE candidates:",
    paste(y_se_candidates, collapse = ", "),
    "\n"
  )


  if (
    length(x_beta) != 1 ||
      length(x_p) != 1 ||
      length(y_beta) != 1 ||
      !("khat_marker" %in% names(dat))
  ) {

    cat(
      "Skipping because required beta, p-value, or marker columns were not identified.\n"
    )

    print(names(dat))
    next
  }


  # Get filename without extension
  pair_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(
    basename(file)
  )


  # Remove ku_/kuf_ prefix and _harmonized suffix
  phenotype_name <- sub(
    "^(ku|kuf)_",
    "",
    pair_name
  )

  phenotype_name <- sub(
    "_harmonized$",
    "",
    phenotype_name
  )


  # Select phenotype-specific lead SNPs and labels
  if (phenotype_name == "AgeofInitiation") {

    liu_lead <- liu_age_of_initiation_lead
    liu_trait <- "Age of Initiation"
    liu_n <- "262,990"

  } else if (phenotype_name == "CigarettesPerDay") {

    liu_lead <- liu_cigarettes_per_day_lead
    liu_trait <- "Cigarettes per Day"
    liu_n <- "263,954"

  } else if (phenotype_name == "DrinksPerWeek") {

    liu_lead <- liu_drinks_per_week_lead
    liu_trait <- "Drinks per Week"
    liu_n <- "537,349"

  } else if (phenotype_name == "SmokingCessation") {

    liu_lead <- liu_smoking_cessation_lead
    liu_trait <- "Smoking Cessation"
    liu_n <- "312,821"

  } else if (phenotype_name == "SmokingInitiation") {

    liu_lead <- liu_smoking_initiation_lead
    liu_trait <- "Smoking Initiation"
    liu_n <- "632,802"

  } else {

    cat(
      "Skipping unrecognized phenotype:",
      phenotype_name,
      "\n"
    )

    next
  }


  cat("Liu phenotype:", liu_trait, "\n")
  cat("Requested lead SNPs:", length(liu_lead), "\n")


  # Identify the comparison-study marker column
  comparison_marker_candidates <- grep(
    "marker$|^SNP$|^rsid$|^RSID$",
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  comparison_marker_candidates <- setdiff(
    comparison_marker_candidates,
    "khat_marker"
  )

  if (length(comparison_marker_candidates) >= 1) {

    comparison_marker <- comparison_marker_candidates[1]

    cat(
      "Liu marker column:",
      comparison_marker,
      "\n"
    )

  } else {

    comparison_marker <- NULL

    cat(
      "No separate Liu marker column detected; ",
      "using khat_marker only.\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  }


  # Keep only phenotype-specific Liu lead SNPs
  if (!is.null(comparison_marker)) {

    dat_lead <- dat[
      dat$khat_marker %in% liu_lead |
        dat[[comparison_marker]] %in% liu_lead,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

  } else {

    dat_lead <- dat[
      dat$khat_marker %in% liu_lead,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  }


  cat("Lead SNP rows found:", nrow(dat_lead), "\n")


  # Determine which requested lead SNPs were found
  found_leads <- dat_lead$khat_marker[
    dat_lead$khat_marker %in% liu_lead
  ]

  if (!is.null(comparison_marker)) {

    found_leads <- c(
      found_leads,
      dat_lead[[comparison_marker]][
        dat_lead[[comparison_marker]] %in% liu_lead
      ]
    )
  }

  found_leads <- unique(
    found_leads[
      !is.na(found_leads) &
        found_leads != ""
    ]
  )

  missing_leads <- setdiff(
    liu_lead,
    found_leads
  )

  cat(
    "Unique lead SNPs found:",
    length(found_leads),
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "Lead SNPs missing:",
    length(missing_leads),
    "\n"
  )


  if (nrow(dat_lead) == 0) {

    cat(
      "No requested Liu lead SNPs were found; skipping.\n"
    )

    next
  }


  # Convert beta and p-value columns to numeric
  dat_lead[[x_beta]] <- as.numeric(
    dat_lead[[x_beta]]
  )

  dat_lead[[x_p]] <- as.numeric(
    dat_lead[[x_p]]
  )

  dat_lead[[y_beta]] <- as.numeric(
    dat_lead[[y_beta]]
  )


  # Reconstruct signed KU/KUF Z-scores and standard errors

  # Z  = sign(beta) * |Phi^(-1)(p / 2)|
  # SE = beta / Z
  dat_lead$z_khat <- ifelse(
    !is.na(dat_lead[[x_beta]]) &
      is.finite(dat_lead[[x_beta]]) &
      !is.na(dat_lead[[x_p]]) &
      is.finite(dat_lead[[x_p]]) &
      dat_lead[[x_p]] > 0 &
      dat_lead[[x_p]] < 1 &
      dat_lead[[x_beta]] != 0,

    sign(dat_lead[[x_beta]]) *
      abs(qnorm(dat_lead[[x_p]] / 2)),

    NA_real_
  )


  dat_lead$se_khat <- ifelse(
    !is.na(dat_lead$z_khat) &
      is.finite(dat_lead$z_khat) &
      dat_lead$z_khat != 0,

    dat_lead[[x_beta]] /
      dat_lead$z_khat,

    NA_real_
  )


  # Obtain Liu standard errors

  if (length(y_se_candidates) == 1) {

    # Use an original Liu SE column when one is available
    y_se <- y_se_candidates[1]

    dat_lead[[y_se]] <- as.numeric(
      dat_lead[[y_se]]
    )

    dat_lead$se_liu <- abs(
      dat_lead[[y_se]]
    )

    liu_se_source <- paste0(
      "reported SE column: ",
      y_se
    )

  } else if (length(y_p) == 1) {

    # Otherwise reconstruct Liu SE from beta and p-value
    dat_lead[[y_p]] <- as.numeric(
      dat_lead[[y_p]]
    )

    dat_lead$z_liu <- ifelse(
      !is.na(dat_lead[[y_beta]]) &
        is.finite(dat_lead[[y_beta]]) &
        !is.na(dat_lead[[y_p]]) &
        is.finite(dat_lead[[y_p]]) &
        dat_lead[[y_p]] > 0 &
        dat_lead[[y_p]] < 1 &
        dat_lead[[y_beta]] != 0,

      sign(dat_lead[[y_beta]]) *
        abs(qnorm(dat_lead[[y_p]] / 2)),

      NA_real_
    )

    dat_lead$se_liu <- ifelse(
      !is.na(dat_lead$z_liu) &
        is.finite(dat_lead$z_liu) &
        dat_lead$z_liu != 0,

      dat_lead[[y_beta]] /
        dat_lead$z_liu,

      NA_real_
    )

    liu_se_source <- paste0(
      "reconstructed from p-value column: ",
      y_p
    )

  } else {

    dat_lead$se_liu <- NA_real_
    liu_se_source <- "unavailable"
  }


  cat(
    "Liu SE source:",
    liu_se_source,
    "\n"
  )


  # Store information required by the plotting cell
  attr(dat_lead, "x_beta") <- x_beta
  attr(dat_lead, "x_p") <- x_p
  attr(dat_lead, "y_beta") <- y_beta
  attr(dat_lead, "y_p") <- if (
    length(y_p) == 1
  ) {
    y_p
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  attr(dat_lead, "comparison_marker") <-
    comparison_marker

  attr(dat_lead, "liu_trait") <- liu_trait
  attr(dat_lead, "liu_n") <- liu_n
  attr(dat_lead, "phenotype_name") <-
    phenotype_name

  attr(dat_lead, "liu_se_source") <-
    liu_se_source


  # Save this phenotype pair to the list
  liu_lead_data[[pair_name]] <- dat_lead


  cat(
    "Rows with usable KU/KUF SE:",
    sum(
      is.finite(dat_lead$se_khat),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "Rows with usable Liu SE:",
    sum(
      is.finite(dat_lead$se_liu),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    "\n"
  )
}


cat(
  "\nNumber of datasets prepared:",
  length(liu_lead_data),
  "\n"
)

print(
  names(liu_lead_data)
)


# Show the number of lead-SNP rows in each dataset
if (length(liu_lead_data) > 0) {

  print(
    sapply(
      liu_lead_data,
      nrow
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Liu: lead SNP beta comparison plots with 95% confidence intervals

# Horizontal error bars:
#   KU/KUF 95% confidence intervals

# Vertical error bars:
#   Liu 95% confidence intervals

cat(
  "Number of Liu datasets to plot:",
  length(liu_lead_data),
  "\n"
)


if (length(liu_lead_data) == 0) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "liu_lead_data is empty. ",
      "Run the preceding preparation cell and inspect its messages."
    )
  )
}


for (pair_name in names(liu_lead_data)) {

  cat("\nPlotting:", pair_name, "\n")

  plot_dat <- liu_lead_data[[pair_name]]


  # Retrieve information stored in Cell 1
  x_beta <- attr(
    plot_dat,
    "x_beta"
  )

  x_p <- attr(
    plot_dat,
    "x_p"
  )

  y_beta <- attr(
    plot_dat,
    "y_beta"
  )

  comparison_marker <- attr(
    plot_dat,
    "comparison_marker"
  )

  liu_trait <- attr(
    plot_dat,
    "liu_trait"
  )

  liu_n <- attr(
    plot_dat,
    "liu_n"
  )

  liu_se_source <- attr(
    plot_dat,
    "liu_se_source"
  )


  # KU versus KUF labels
  if (grepl("^ku_", pair_name)) {

    khat_trait <- "Khat Use"
    khat_n_label <- "KU N = 33,210"

  } else {

    khat_trait <- "Khat Use Frequency"
    khat_n_label <- "KUF N = 25,869"
  }


  liu_n_label <- paste0(
    liu_trait,
    " N = ",
    liu_n
  )


  # Keep rows with complete beta and SE values
  plot_dat <- plot_dat[
    !is.na(plot_dat[[x_beta]]) &
      !is.na(plot_dat[[y_beta]]) &
      !is.na(plot_dat$se_khat) &
      !is.na(plot_dat$se_liu) &
      is.finite(plot_dat$se_khat) &
      is.finite(plot_dat$se_liu) &
      plot_dat$se_khat >= 0 &
      plot_dat$se_liu >= 0,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  cat(
    "Rows remaining after beta/SE filtering:",
    nrow(plot_dat),
    "\n"
  )


  if (nrow(plot_dat) == 0) {

    cat(
      "Skipping plot because no lead SNPs have complete beta and SE values.\n"
    )

    next
  }


  # Orient the KU/KUF beta positively.
  #
  # Both aligned beta estimates are flipped together.
  # Standard errors remain unchanged.
  flip_rows <- plot_dat[[x_beta]] < 0

  cat(
    "Lead SNP rows flipped:",
    sum(flip_rows),
    "\n"
  )

  plot_dat[[x_beta]][flip_rows] <-
    -plot_dat[[x_beta]][flip_rows]

  plot_dat[[y_beta]][flip_rows] <-
    -plot_dat[[y_beta]][flip_rows]


  # Calculate 95% confidence intervals
  plot_dat$x_ci_lower <-
    plot_dat[[x_beta]] -
    1.96 * plot_dat$se_khat

  plot_dat$x_ci_upper <-
    plot_dat[[x_beta]] +
    1.96 * plot_dat$se_khat

  plot_dat$y_ci_lower <-
    plot_dat[[y_beta]] -
    1.96 * plot_dat$se_liu

  plot_dat$y_ci_upper <-
    plot_dat[[y_beta]] +
    1.96 * plot_dat$se_liu


  # Highlight SNPs with KU/KUF p < 1e-5
  plot_dat$highlight <-
    !is.na(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
      plot_dat[[x_p]] < ku_sug_thresh


  cat(
    "Complete lead SNP rows plotted:",
    nrow(plot_dat),
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "Lead SNPs highlighted at KU/KUF P < ",
    ku_sug_thresh,
    ": ",
    sum(plot_dat$highlight),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  # Create plotting marker labels
  if (
    !is.null(comparison_marker) &&
      comparison_marker %in% names(plot_dat)
  ) {

    plot_dat$plot_marker <- ifelse(
      !is.na(plot_dat[[comparison_marker]]) &
        plot_dat[[comparison_marker]] != "",
      plot_dat[[comparison_marker]],
      plot_dat$khat_marker
    )

  } else {

    plot_dat$plot_marker <-
      plot_dat$khat_marker
  }



  # Count plotted variants with nominal KU/KUF association (P < 0.05)
  khat_p05_count <- sum(
    !is.na(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
      is.finite(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
      plot_dat[[x_p]] < 0.05
  )

  cat(
    khat_trait,
    " variants with P < 0.05:",
    khat_p05_count,
    "\n"
  )

  # Pearson correlation
  if (
    nrow(plot_dat) >= 3 &&
      length(
        unique(plot_dat[[x_beta]])
      ) >= 2 &&
      length(
        unique(plot_dat[[y_beta]])
      ) >= 2
  ) {

    pearson_test <- cor.test(
      plot_dat[[x_beta]],
      plot_dat[[y_beta]],
      method = "pearson"
    )

    pearson_r <- unname(
      pearson_test$estimate
    )

    pearson_p <- pearson_test$p.value

    title_correlation <- paste0(
      " | r = ",
      round(
        pearson_r,
        4
      )
    )

    correlation_label <- paste0(
      "Pearson p = ",
      format.pval(
        pearson_p,
        digits = 3,
        eps = 1e-300
      )
    )

  } else {

    title_correlation <- ""

    correlation_label <- paste0(
      "Pearson correlation not calculated; ",
      nrow(plot_dat),
      " complete lead SNP",
      ifelse(
        nrow(plot_dat) == 1,
        "",
        "s"
      ),
      " available"
    )
  }


  # Create plot
  # Generalized Deming regression
  deming_results <- get_deming_results(
    plot_dat = plot_dat,
    x_beta = x_beta,
    y_beta = y_beta,
    x_se = "se_khat",
    y_se = "se_liu"
  )

  add_comparison_summary(
    plot_dat = plot_dat,
    x_beta = x_beta,
    y_beta = y_beta,
    x_p = x_p,
    khat_trait = khat_trait,
    comparison_label = paste0("Liu ", liu_trait),
    deming_results = deming_results
  )


  p <- ggplot(
    plot_dat,
    aes(
      x = .data[[x_beta]],
      y = .data[[y_beta]]
    )
  ) +

    # Horizontal KU/KUF 95% confidence intervals
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        xmin = x_ci_lower,
        xmax = x_ci_upper
      ),
      orientation = "y",
      width = 0,
      alpha = 0.4,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    # Vertical Liu 95% confidence intervals
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = y_ci_lower,
        ymax = y_ci_upper
      ),
      width = 0,
      alpha = 0.4,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    # Plot all available phenotype-specific lead SNPs
    geom_point(
      alpha = 0.6,
      size = 3
    ) +

    # Ordinary least-squares line of best fit
    {
      if (
        nrow(plot_dat) >= 2 &&
          length(unique(plot_dat[[x_beta]])) >= 2
      ) {

        geom_smooth(
          method = "lm",
          formula = y ~ x,
          se = FALSE,
          color = "blue",
          linetype = "dashed",
          linewidth = 0.8
        )
      }
    } +

    # Generalized Deming regression line
    {
      if (
        is.finite(deming_results$intercept) &&
          is.finite(deming_results$slope)
      ) {

        geom_abline(
          intercept = deming_results$intercept,
          slope = deming_results$slope,
          color = "blue",
          linetype = "solid",
          linewidth = 0.8
        )
      }
    } +

    # Highlight SNPs with KU/KUF p < 1e-5
    geom_point(
      data = subset(
        plot_dat,
        highlight
      ),
      color = "red",
      size = 3.5
    ) +

    # Label highlighted SNPs
    geom_text_repel(
      data = subset(
        plot_dat,
        highlight
      ),
      aes(
        label = plot_marker
      ),
      color = "red",
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.3,
      point.padding = 0.2
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0
    ) +

    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0
    ) +

    theme_bw() +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 11
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 6
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "NGAP: ",
        khat_trait,
        " x Liu: ",
        liu_trait,
        " Lead SNPs",
        title_correlation
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        khat_n_label,
        " | ",
        liu_n_label,
        " | Lead SNPs plotted = ",
        nrow(plot_dat),
        " | Error bars = 95% CIs",
        " | ",
        deming_results$label,
        " | ",
        correlation_label
      ),
      x = paste0(
        khat_trait,
        " beta"
      ),
      y = paste0(
        liu_trait,
        " beta"
      )
    )

  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
# Liu: Smoking Initiation lead SNP plots only

# Plot only Smoking Initiation lead SNPs with KU/KUF P < 0.05.

# Horizontal error bars:
#   KU/KUF 95% confidence intervals

# Vertical error bars:
#   Liu Smoking Initiation 95% confidence intervals

# Red points:
#   KU/KUF P < 1e-5




# Select only the KU and KUF Smoking Initiation datasets
smkinit_names <- names(liu_lead_data)[
  grepl(
    "SmokingInitiation",
    names(liu_lead_data),
    fixed = TRUE
  )
]


cat(
  "Smoking Initiation datasets found:",
  length(smkinit_names),
  "\n"
)

print(smkinit_names)


if (length(smkinit_names) == 0) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "No Smoking Initiation datasets were found in liu_lead_data. ",
      "Expected names containing 'SmokingInitiation'."
    )
  )
}


for (pair_name in smkinit_names) {

  cat("\nPlotting:", pair_name, "\n")

  plot_dat <- liu_lead_data[[pair_name]]


  # Retrieve stored column names and labels
  x_beta <- attr(
    plot_dat,
    "x_beta"
  )

  x_p <- attr(
    plot_dat,
    "x_p"
  )

  y_beta <- attr(
    plot_dat,
    "y_beta"
  )

  comparison_marker <- attr(
    plot_dat,
    "comparison_marker"
  )

  liu_trait <- attr(
    plot_dat,
    "liu_trait"
  )

  liu_n <- attr(
    plot_dat,
    "liu_n"
  )

  liu_se_source <- attr(
    plot_dat,
    "liu_se_source"
  )


  # Fallback labels in case attributes are absent
  if (
    is.null(liu_trait) ||
      length(liu_trait) == 0
  ) {

    liu_trait <- "Smoking Initiation"
  }

  if (
    is.null(liu_n) ||
      length(liu_n) == 0
  ) {

    liu_n <- "632,802"
  }


  # Identify KU versus KUF
  if (grepl("^ku_", pair_name)) {

    khat_trait <- "Khat Use"
    khat_n_label <- "KU N = 33,210"

  } else {

    khat_trait <- "Khat Use Frequency"
    khat_n_label <- "KUF N = 25,869"
  }


  liu_n_label <- paste0(
    "Smoking Initiation N = ",
    liu_n
  )


  # Keep only rows with:
  #   1. complete beta estimates
  #   2. complete SE estimates
  #   3. a valid KU/KUF p-value
  #   4. KU/KUF P < 0.05
  plot_dat <- plot_dat[
    !is.na(plot_dat[[x_beta]]) &
      !is.na(plot_dat[[y_beta]]) &
      !is.na(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
      !is.na(plot_dat$se_khat) &
      !is.na(plot_dat$se_liu) &
      is.finite(plot_dat[[x_beta]]) &
      is.finite(plot_dat[[y_beta]]) &
      is.finite(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
      is.finite(plot_dat$se_khat) &
      is.finite(plot_dat$se_liu) &
      plot_dat[[x_p]] > 0 &
      plot_dat[[x_p]] < 0.05 &
      plot_dat$se_khat >= 0 &
      plot_dat$se_liu >= 0,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  cat(
    "Smoking Initiation lead SNPs with KU/KUF P < 0.05:",
    nrow(plot_dat),
    "\n"
  )


  if (nrow(plot_dat) == 0) {

    cat(
      "Skipping because no complete Smoking Initiation ",
      "lead SNPs had KU/KUF P < 0.05.\n",
      sep = ""
    )

    next
  }


  # Orient KU/KUF beta positively.
  #
  # Flip both aligned beta estimates together.
  # Standard errors remain unchanged.
  flip_rows <- plot_dat[[x_beta]] < 0

  cat(
    "Lead SNP rows flipped:",
    sum(flip_rows),
    "\n"
  )

  plot_dat[[x_beta]][flip_rows] <-
    -plot_dat[[x_beta]][flip_rows]

  plot_dat[[y_beta]][flip_rows] <-
    -plot_dat[[y_beta]][flip_rows]


  # Calculate 95% confidence intervals
  plot_dat$x_ci_lower <-
    plot_dat[[x_beta]] -
    1.96 * plot_dat$se_khat

  plot_dat$x_ci_upper <-
    plot_dat[[x_beta]] +
    1.96 * plot_dat$se_khat

  plot_dat$y_ci_lower <-
    plot_dat[[y_beta]] -
    1.96 * plot_dat$se_liu

  plot_dat$y_ci_upper <-
    plot_dat[[y_beta]] +
    1.96 * plot_dat$se_liu


  # Highlight KU/KUF P < 1e-5
  plot_dat$highlight <-
    plot_dat[[x_p]] < ku_sug_thresh


  cat(
    "Lead SNPs highlighted at KU/KUF P < ",
    ku_sug_thresh,
    ": ",
    sum(plot_dat$highlight),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  # Create marker labels
  if (
    !is.null(comparison_marker) &&
      comparison_marker %in% names(plot_dat)
  ) {

    plot_dat$plot_marker <- ifelse(
      !is.na(plot_dat[[comparison_marker]]) &
        plot_dat[[comparison_marker]] != "",
      plot_dat[[comparison_marker]],
      plot_dat$khat_marker
    )

  } else {

    plot_dat$plot_marker <-
      plot_dat$khat_marker
  }



  # Count plotted variants with nominal KU/KUF association (P < 0.05)
  khat_p05_count <- sum(
    !is.na(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
      is.finite(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
      plot_dat[[x_p]] < 0.05
  )

  cat(
    khat_trait,
    " variants with P < 0.05:",
    khat_p05_count,
    "\n"
  )

  # Pearson correlation among the plotted SNPs only
  if (
    nrow(plot_dat) >= 3 &&
      length(unique(plot_dat[[x_beta]])) >= 2 &&
      length(unique(plot_dat[[y_beta]])) >= 2
  ) {

    pearson_test <- cor.test(
      plot_dat[[x_beta]],
      plot_dat[[y_beta]],
      method = "pearson"
    )

    pearson_r <- unname(
      pearson_test$estimate
    )

    pearson_p <- pearson_test$p.value

    title_correlation <- paste0(
      " | r = ",
      round(
        pearson_r,
        4
      )
    )

    correlation_label <- paste0(
      "Pearson p = ",
      format.pval(
        pearson_p,
        digits = 3,
        eps = 1e-300
      )
    )

  } else {

    title_correlation <- ""

    correlation_label <- paste0(
      "Pearson correlation not calculated; ",
      nrow(plot_dat),
      " complete lead SNP",
      ifelse(
        nrow(plot_dat) == 1,
        "",
        "s"
      ),
      " available"
    )
  }


  # Create plot
  # Generalized Deming regression
  deming_results <- get_deming_results(
    plot_dat = plot_dat,
    x_beta = x_beta,
    y_beta = y_beta,
    x_se = "se_khat",
    y_se = "se_liu"
  )

  # Do not add this P < 0.05-only visualization to comparison_summary.
  # The complete Liu Smoking Initiation comparison is already added in the
  # preceding all-Liu plotting cell, before applying the nominal P < 0.05 filter.
  # This keeps the summary-table denominator equal to all usable comparison SNPs
  # and lets the final column report how many of those have KU/KUF P < 0.05.


  p <- ggplot(
    plot_dat,
    aes(
      x = .data[[x_beta]],
      y = .data[[y_beta]]
    )
  ) +

    # Horizontal KU/KUF 95% confidence intervals
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        xmin = x_ci_lower,
        xmax = x_ci_upper
      ),
      orientation = "y",
      width = 0,
      alpha = 0.4,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    # Vertical Liu 95% confidence intervals
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = y_ci_lower,
        ymax = y_ci_upper
      ),
      width = 0,
      alpha = 0.4,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    # Plot Smoking Initiation lead SNPs
    geom_point(
      alpha = 0.6,
      size = 3
    ) +

    # Ordinary least-squares line of best fit
    {
      if (
        nrow(plot_dat) >= 2 &&
          length(unique(plot_dat[[x_beta]])) >= 2
      ) {

        geom_smooth(
          method = "lm",
          formula = y ~ x,
          se = FALSE,
          color = "blue",
          linetype = "dashed",
          linewidth = 0.8
        )
      }
    } +

    # Generalized Deming regression line
    {
      if (
        is.finite(deming_results$intercept) &&
          is.finite(deming_results$slope)
      ) {

        geom_abline(
          intercept = deming_results$intercept,
          slope = deming_results$slope,
          color = "blue",
          linetype = "solid",
          linewidth = 0.8
        )
      }
    } +

    # Highlight SNPs with KU/KUF P < 1e-5
    geom_point(
      data = subset(
        plot_dat,
        highlight
      ),
      color = "red",
      size = 3.5
    ) +

    # Label only highlighted SNPs
    geom_text_repel(
      data = subset(
        plot_dat,
        highlight
      ),
      aes(
        label = plot_marker
      ),
      color = "red",
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.3,
      point.padding = 0.2
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0
    ) +

    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0
    ) +

    theme_bw() +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 9
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 6
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "NGAP: ",
        khat_trait,
        " x Liu: Smoking Initiation Lead SNPs",
        " with KU/KUF P < 0.05",
        title_correlation
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        khat_n_label,
        " | ",
        liu_n_label,
        " | Lead SNPs plotted = ",
        nrow(plot_dat),
        " | Error bars = 95% CIs",
        " | ",
        deming_results$label,
        " | ",
        correlation_label
      ),
      x = paste0(
        khat_trait,
        " beta"
      ),
      y = "Smoking Initiation beta"
)
  print(p)
}
```
