```{r}
# Saunders: plot all available lead SNPs with 95% confidence intervals

# For every phenotype:
#   - Plot every available Saunders lead SNP.

# For Smoking Initiation:
#   - Also create a second figure containing only lead SNPs
#     with KU/KUF P < 0.05.

# Horizontal error bars:
#   KU/KUF 95% confidence intervals

# Vertical error bars:
#   Saunders 95% confidence intervals

# Red points:
#   KU/KUF P < 1e-5


# Saunders input files
saunders_dir <- "/Users/nico/work/sud/saunders_lifted_harmonized"

files <- list.files(
  path = saunders_dir,
  pattern = "^(ku|kuf)_(AgeSmk|CigDay|DrnkWk|SmkCes|SmkInit)_(AFR|AMR|EAS|EUR)_harmonized\\.txt$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

files <- sort(files)


cat(
  "Saunders files found:",
  length(files),
  "\n"
)

print(basename(files))


if (length(files) == 0) {

  stop(
    "No Saunders harmonized files were found in: ",
    saunders_dir
  )
}


# Function used to create each plot
make_saunders_plot <- function(
  plot_dat,
  x_beta,
  y_beta,
  x_p,
  khat_trait,
  khat_n_label,
  trait_label,
  saunders_label,
  saunders_n_label,
  saunders_se_source,
  filter_label = NULL
) {

  if (nrow(plot_dat) == 0) {

    cat(
      "Skipping plot because no variants remained.\n"
    )

    return(invisible(NULL))
  }



  # Count plotted variants with nominal KU/KUF association (P < 0.05)
  khat_p05_count <- sum(
    !is.na(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
      is.finite(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
      plot_dat[[x_p]] < 0.05
  )

  cat(
    khat_trait,
    " variants with P < 0.05:",
    khat_p05_count,
    "\n"
  )

  # Pearson correlation is calculated using only
  # the variants shown in the current figure.
  if (
    nrow(plot_dat) >= 3 &&
      length(unique(plot_dat[[x_beta]])) >= 2 &&
      length(unique(plot_dat[[y_beta]])) >= 2
  ) {

    pearson_test <- cor.test(
      plot_dat[[x_beta]],
      plot_dat[[y_beta]],
      method = "pearson"
    )

    title_correlation <- paste0(
      " | r = ",
      round(
        unname(pearson_test$estimate),
        4
      )
    )

    correlation_label <- paste0(
      "Pearson p = ",
      format.pval(
        pearson_test$p.value,
        digits = 3,
        eps = 1e-300
      )
    )

  } else {

    title_correlation <- ""

    correlation_label <- paste0(
      "Pearson correlation not calculated; ",
      nrow(plot_dat),
      " complete lead SNP",
      ifelse(
        nrow(plot_dat) == 1,
        "",
        "s"
      ),
      " available"
    )
  }


  # Add threshold wording only to the filtered
  # Smoking Initiation figure.
  if (is.null(filter_label)) {

    title_filter_text <- ""
    subtitle_filter_text <- ""

  } else {

    title_filter_text <- paste0(
      " ",
      filter_label
    )

    subtitle_filter_text <- paste0(
      " | ",
      filter_label
    )
  }


  # Generalized Deming regression
  deming_results <- get_deming_results(
    plot_dat = plot_dat,
    x_beta = x_beta,
    y_beta = y_beta,
    x_se = "se_khat",
    y_se = "se_saunders"
  )

  add_comparison_summary(
    plot_dat = plot_dat,
    x_beta = x_beta,
    y_beta = y_beta,
    x_p = x_p,
    khat_trait = khat_trait,
    comparison_label = saunders_label,
    deming_results = deming_results
  )


  p <- ggplot(
    plot_dat,
    aes(
      x = .data[[x_beta]],
      y = .data[[y_beta]]
    )
  ) +

    # Horizontal KU/KUF 95% confidence intervals
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        xmin = x_ci_lower,
        xmax = x_ci_upper
      ),
      orientation = "y",
      width = 0,
      alpha = 0.4,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    # Vertical Saunders 95% confidence intervals
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = y_ci_lower,
        ymax = y_ci_upper
      ),
      width = 0,
      alpha = 0.4,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    # Plot Saunders lead SNPs
    geom_point(
      alpha = 0.6,
      size = 3
    ) +

    # Ordinary least-squares line of best fit
    {
      if (
        nrow(plot_dat) >= 2 &&
          length(unique(plot_dat[[x_beta]])) >= 2
      ) {

        geom_smooth(
          method = "lm",
          formula = y ~ x,
          se = FALSE,
          color = "blue",
          linetype = "dashed",
          linewidth = 0.8
        )
      }
    } +

    # Generalized Deming regression line
    {
      if (
        is.finite(deming_results$intercept) &&
          is.finite(deming_results$slope)
      ) {

        geom_abline(
          intercept = deming_results$intercept,
          slope = deming_results$slope,
          color = "blue",
          linetype = "solid",
          linewidth = 0.8
        )
      }
    } +

    # Highlight KU/KUF P < 1e-5
    geom_point(
      data = subset(
        plot_dat,
        highlight
      ),
      color = "red",
      size = 3.5
    ) +

    # Label only highlighted SNPs
    geom_text_repel(
      data = subset(
        plot_dat,
        highlight
      ),
      aes(
        label = plot_marker
      ),
      color = "red",
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.3,
      point.padding = 0.2
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0
    ) +

    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0
    ) +

    theme_bw() +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 8
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 5
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "NGAP: ",
        khat_trait,
        " x ",
        saunders_label,
        " Lead SNPs",
        title_filter_text,
        title_correlation
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        khat_n_label,
        " | ",
        saunders_n_label,
        " | Lead SNPs plotted = ",
        nrow(plot_dat),
        subtitle_filter_text,
        " | Error bars = 95% CIs",
        " | ",
        deming_results$label,
        " | ",
        correlation_label
      ),
      x = paste0(
        khat_trait,
        " beta"
      ),
      y = paste0(
        trait_label,
        " beta"
      )
    )


  print(p)
}


# Process and plot each Saunders file
for (file in files) {

  cat("\nProcessing:", basename(file), "\n")


  dat <- read.table(
    file,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    fill = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE,
    quote = "",
    comment.char = ""
  )


  # Identify required columns
  x_beta <- grep(
    "^beta_ku$|^beta_kuf$",
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE
  )

  y_beta <- grep(
    "_to_khat_A1$",
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE
  )

  x_p <- grep(
    "^p_ku$|^p_kuf$",
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE
  )


  cat(
    "x_beta:",
    paste(x_beta, collapse = ", "),
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "y_beta:",
    paste(y_beta, collapse = ", "),
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "x_p:",
    paste(x_p, collapse = ", "),
    "\n"
  )


  if (
    length(x_beta) != 1 ||
      length(y_beta) != 1 ||
      length(x_p) != 1 ||
      !("khat_marker" %in% names(dat))
  ) {

    cat(
      "Skipping because required columns were not identified.\n"
    )

    print(names(dat))

    next
  }


  # Identify the Saunders p-value column.
  
  # First prefer an exact P column.
  # Otherwise search common p-value column names,
  # excluding the KU/KUF p-value column.
  if ("P" %in% names(dat)) {

    y_p <- "P"

  } else {

    y_p_candidates <- grep(
      "^p$|^pval$|^p_value$|^pvalue$|pval|p_value|pvalue",
      names(dat),
      value = TRUE,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )

    y_p_candidates <- setdiff(
      y_p_candidates,
      x_p
    )

    if (length(y_p_candidates) >= 1) {

      y_p <- y_p_candidates[1]

    } else {

      y_p <- character(0)
    }
  }


  # Search for a reported Saunders SE column.
  
  # Exclude columns that appear to belong to KU/KUF.
  y_se_candidates <- grep(
    "^SE$|^se$|stderr|std_err|standard_error",
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  y_se_candidates <- y_se_candidates[
    !grepl(
      "ku|kuf|khat",
      y_se_candidates,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ]


  cat(
    "Saunders p-value candidate:",
    paste(y_p, collapse = ", "),
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "Saunders SE candidates:",
    paste(y_se_candidates, collapse = ", "),
    "\n"
  )


  # Convert required columns to numeric
  dat[[x_beta]] <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(dat[[x_beta]])
  )

  dat[[y_beta]] <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(dat[[y_beta]])
  )

  dat[[x_p]] <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(dat[[x_p]])
  )

  dat$khat_marker <- as.character(
    dat$khat_marker
  )


  # Parse filename
  
  # Expected:
  # ku_AgeSmk_AFR_harmonized.txt
  # kuf_SmkInit_EUR_harmonized.txt
  file_name <- basename(file)

  filename_match <- regexec(
    pattern = "^(ku|kuf)_(AgeSmk|CigDay|DrnkWk|SmkCes|SmkInit)_(AFR|AMR|EAS|EUR)_harmonized\\.txt$",
    text = file_name
  )

  filename_parts <- regmatches(
    file_name,
    filename_match
  )[[1]]


  if (length(filename_parts) != 4) {

    cat(
      "Skipping because filename did not match the expected Saunders format:",
      file_name,
      "\n"
    )

    next
  }


  khat_raw <- filename_parts[2]
  trait_raw <- filename_parts[3]
  ancestry <- filename_parts[4]


  cat("Khat phenotype:", khat_raw, "\n")
  cat("Phenotype:", trait_raw, "\n")
  cat("Ancestry:", ancestry, "\n")


  # KU/KUF labels
  if (khat_raw == "ku") {

    khat_trait <- "Khat Use"
    khat_n_label <- "KU N = 33,210"

  } else if (khat_raw == "kuf") {

    khat_trait <- "Khat Use Frequency"
    khat_n_label <- "KUF N = 25,869"

  } else {

    cat(
      "Skipping because khat phenotype was not recognized:",
      khat_raw,
      "\n"
    )

    next
  }


  # Saunders labels
  trait_label <- switch(
    trait_raw,
    AgeSmk = "Age of Smoking Initiation",
    CigDay = "Cigarettes per Day",
    DrnkWk = "Drinks per Week",
    SmkCes = "Smoking Cessation",
    SmkInit = "Smoking Initiation",
    NA_character_
  )


  ancestry_label <- switch(
    ancestry,
    AFR = "African",
    AMR = "Admixed American",
    EAS = "East Asian",
    EUR = "European",
    NA_character_
  )


  if (
    is.na(trait_label) ||
      is.na(ancestry_label)
  ) {

    cat(
      "Skipping because phenotype or ancestry was not recognized.\n"
    )

    next
  }


  # Match filename phenotype to lead-vector name
  lead_trait_name <- switch(
    trait_raw,
    AgeSmk = "agesmk",
    CigDay = "cigday",
    DrnkWk = "drnkwk",
    SmkCes = "smkcess",
    SmkInit = "smkinit",
    NA_character_
  )


  if (is.na(lead_trait_name)) {

    cat(
      "Skipping unrecognized phenotype:",
      trait_raw,
      "\n"
    )

    next
  }


  lead_vector_name <- paste0(
    "saunders_",
    lead_trait_name,
    "_",
    tolower(ancestry),
    "_lead"
  )


  cat(
    "Expected lead vector:",
    lead_vector_name,
    "\n"
  )


  if (!exists(
    lead_vector_name,
    inherits = TRUE
  )) {

    cat(
      "Skipping because no Saunders lead-SNP vector exists for ",
      trait_raw,
      " ",
      ancestry,
      ".\n",
      sep = ""
    )

    next
  }


  saunders_lead <- get(
    lead_vector_name,
    inherits = TRUE
  )

  saunders_lead <- unique(
    as.character(saunders_lead)
  )

  saunders_lead <- saunders_lead[
    !is.na(saunders_lead) &
      saunders_lead != ""
  ]


  cat(
    "Requested Saunders lead SNPs:",
    length(saunders_lead),
    "\n"
  )


  if (length(saunders_lead) == 0) {

    cat(
      "Skipping because the matching lead-SNP vector is empty.\n"
    )

    next
  }


  # Identify Saunders marker column
  marker_candidates <- grep(
    "marker$|^SNP$|^rsid$|^RSID$",
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  marker_candidates <- setdiff(
    marker_candidates,
    "khat_marker"
  )


  if (length(marker_candidates) > 0) {

    comparison_marker <- marker_candidates[1]

    dat[[comparison_marker]] <- as.character(
      dat[[comparison_marker]]
    )

    cat(
      "Saunders marker column:",
      comparison_marker,
      "\n"
    )

  } else {

    comparison_marker <- NULL

    cat(
      "No separate Saunders marker column detected; ",
      "using khat_marker only.\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  }


  # Keep Saunders lead SNPs
  if (!is.null(comparison_marker)) {

    dat_lead <- dat[
      dat$khat_marker %in% saunders_lead |
        dat[[comparison_marker]] %in% saunders_lead,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

  } else {

    dat_lead <- dat[
      dat$khat_marker %in% saunders_lead,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  }


  cat(
    "Lead SNP rows found:",
    nrow(dat_lead),
    "\n"
  )


  # Retain rows with both beta estimates
  dat_lead <- dat_lead[
    !is.na(dat_lead[[x_beta]]) &
      !is.na(dat_lead[[y_beta]]) &
      is.finite(dat_lead[[x_beta]]) &
      is.finite(dat_lead[[y_beta]]),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  if (nrow(dat_lead) == 0) {

    cat(
      "Skipping because no complete Saunders lead SNPs were found.\n"
    )

    next
  }


  # Reconstruct signed KU/KUF Z-score and standard error
  #
  # Z  = sign(beta) * |Phi^(-1)(p / 2)|
  # SE = beta / Z
  dat_lead$z_khat <- ifelse(
    !is.na(dat_lead[[x_beta]]) &
      is.finite(dat_lead[[x_beta]]) &
      !is.na(dat_lead[[x_p]]) &
      is.finite(dat_lead[[x_p]]) &
      dat_lead[[x_p]] > 0 &
      dat_lead[[x_p]] < 1 &
      dat_lead[[x_beta]] != 0,

    sign(dat_lead[[x_beta]]) *
      abs(qnorm(dat_lead[[x_p]] / 2)),

    NA_real_
  )


  dat_lead$se_khat <- ifelse(
    !is.na(dat_lead$z_khat) &
      is.finite(dat_lead$z_khat) &
      dat_lead$z_khat != 0,

    dat_lead[[x_beta]] /
      dat_lead$z_khat,

    NA_real_
  )


  # Obtain Saunders SE.
  
  # Prefer a reported SE column when exactly one is found.
  # Otherwise reconstruct SE from Saunders beta and p-value.
  if (length(y_se_candidates) == 1) {

    y_se <- y_se_candidates[1]

    dat_lead[[y_se]] <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(dat_lead[[y_se]])
    )

    dat_lead$se_saunders <- abs(
      dat_lead[[y_se]]
    )

    saunders_se_source <- paste0(
      "reported SE column ",
      y_se
    )

  } else if (length(y_p) == 1) {

    dat_lead[[y_p]] <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(dat_lead[[y_p]])
    )

    dat_lead$z_saunders <- ifelse(
      !is.na(dat_lead[[y_beta]]) &
        is.finite(dat_lead[[y_beta]]) &
        !is.na(dat_lead[[y_p]]) &
        is.finite(dat_lead[[y_p]]) &
        dat_lead[[y_p]] > 0 &
        dat_lead[[y_p]] < 1 &
        dat_lead[[y_beta]] != 0,

      sign(dat_lead[[y_beta]]) *
        abs(qnorm(dat_lead[[y_p]] / 2)),

      NA_real_
    )


    dat_lead$se_saunders <- ifelse(
      !is.na(dat_lead$z_saunders) &
        is.finite(dat_lead$z_saunders) &
        dat_lead$z_saunders != 0,

      dat_lead[[y_beta]] /
        dat_lead$z_saunders,

      NA_real_
    )

    saunders_se_source <- paste0(
      "reconstructed from p-value column ",
      y_p
    )

  } else {

    dat_lead$se_saunders <- NA_real_
    saunders_se_source <- "unavailable"
  }


  cat(
    "Saunders SE source:",
    saunders_se_source,
    "\n"
  )


  # Keep variants with usable beta and SE values
  dat_lead <- dat_lead[
    !is.na(dat_lead$se_khat) &
      !is.na(dat_lead$se_saunders) &
      is.finite(dat_lead$se_khat) &
      is.finite(dat_lead$se_saunders) &
      dat_lead$se_khat >= 0 &
      dat_lead$se_saunders >= 0,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  cat(
    "Lead SNP rows with usable SEs:",
    nrow(dat_lead),
    "\n"
  )


  if (nrow(dat_lead) == 0) {

    cat(
      "Skipping because no lead SNPs had usable KU/KUF and Saunders SEs.\n"
    )

    next
  }


  # Orient KU/KUF beta positively.
  #
  # Flip both aligned beta estimates.
  # Do not flip standard errors.
  flip_rows <- dat_lead[[x_beta]] < 0


  cat(
    "Lead SNP rows flipped:",
    sum(flip_rows, na.rm = TRUE),
    "\n"
  )


  dat_lead[[x_beta]][flip_rows] <-
    -dat_lead[[x_beta]][flip_rows]

  dat_lead[[y_beta]][flip_rows] <-
    -dat_lead[[y_beta]][flip_rows]


  # Calculate 95% confidence intervals
  dat_lead$x_ci_lower <-
    dat_lead[[x_beta]] -
    1.96 * dat_lead$se_khat

  dat_lead$x_ci_upper <-
    dat_lead[[x_beta]] +
    1.96 * dat_lead$se_khat

  dat_lead$y_ci_lower <-
    dat_lead[[y_beta]] -
    1.96 * dat_lead$se_saunders

  dat_lead$y_ci_upper <-
    dat_lead[[y_beta]] +
    1.96 * dat_lead$se_saunders


  # Highlight KU/KUF P < 1e-5
  dat_lead$highlight <-
    !is.na(dat_lead[[x_p]]) &
      is.finite(dat_lead[[x_p]]) &
      dat_lead[[x_p]] < ku_sug_thresh


  # Create marker labels
  if (!is.null(comparison_marker)) {

    dat_lead$plot_marker <- ifelse(
      !is.na(dat_lead[[comparison_marker]]) &
        dat_lead[[comparison_marker]] != "",
      dat_lead[[comparison_marker]],
      dat_lead$khat_marker
    )

  } else {

    dat_lead$plot_marker <-
      dat_lead$khat_marker
  }


  # Saunders sample size
  saunders_n <- dplyr::case_when(
    trait_raw == "SmkInit" & ancestry == "EUR" ~ 805431,
    trait_raw == "SmkInit" & ancestry == "AMR" ~ 286026,
    trait_raw == "SmkInit" & ancestry == "AFR" ~ 119589,
    trait_raw == "SmkInit" & ancestry == "EAS" ~ 296395,

    trait_raw == "AgeSmk" & ancestry == "EUR" ~ 323836,
    trait_raw == "AgeSmk" & ancestry == "AMR" ~ 33914,
    trait_raw == "AgeSmk" & ancestry == "AFR" ~ 17508,
    trait_raw == "AgeSmk" & ancestry == "EAS" ~ 63353,

    trait_raw == "CigDay" & ancestry == "EUR" ~ 326497,
    trait_raw == "CigDay" & ancestry == "AMR" ~ 35129,
    trait_raw == "CigDay" & ancestry == "AFR" ~ 20157,
    trait_raw == "CigDay" & ancestry == "EAS" ~ 108275,

    trait_raw == "SmkCes" & ancestry == "EUR" ~ 388313,
    trait_raw == "SmkCes" & ancestry == "AMR" ~ 90525,
    trait_raw == "SmkCes" & ancestry == "AFR" ~ 34970,
    trait_raw == "SmkCes" & ancestry == "EAS" ~ 121859,

    trait_raw == "DrnkWk" & ancestry == "EUR" ~ 666978,
    trait_raw == "DrnkWk" & ancestry == "AMR" ~ 274707,
    trait_raw == "DrnkWk" & ancestry == "AFR" ~ 95343,
    trait_raw == "DrnkWk" & ancestry == "EAS" ~ 160775,

    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )


  saunders_n_label <- if (!is.na(saunders_n)) {

    paste0(
      trait_label,
      " ",
      ancestry,
      " N = ",
      format(
        saunders_n,
        big.mark = ",",
        scientific = FALSE,
        trim = TRUE
      )
    )

  } else {

    paste0(
      trait_label,
      " ",
      ancestry,
      " N = NA"
    )
  }


  saunders_label <- paste0(
    "Saunders ",
    trait_label,
    " ",
    ancestry_label
  )


  # Figure 1:
  # Plot every available lead SNP
  plot_dat_all <- dat_lead


  cat(
    "Plotting all complete lead SNPs:",
    nrow(plot_dat_all),
    "\n"
  )


  make_saunders_plot(
    plot_dat = plot_dat_all,
    x_beta = x_beta,
    y_beta = y_beta,
    x_p = x_p,
    khat_trait = khat_trait,
    khat_n_label = khat_n_label,
    trait_label = trait_label,
    saunders_label = saunders_label,
    saunders_n_label = saunders_n_label,
    saunders_se_source = saunders_se_source,
    filter_label = NULL
  )


  # Figure 2:
  # For Smoking Initiation only, plot again after
  # requiring KU/KUF P < 0.05.
  if (trait_raw == "SmkInit") {

    plot_dat_p05 <- dat_lead[
      !is.na(dat_lead[[x_p]]) &
        is.finite(dat_lead[[x_p]]) &
        dat_lead[[x_p]] > 0 &
        dat_lead[[x_p]] < 0.05,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]


    cat(
      "Smoking Initiation lead SNPs with KU/KUF P < 0.05:",
      nrow(plot_dat_p05),
      "\n"
    )


    if (nrow(plot_dat_p05) == 0) {

      cat(
        "No Smoking Initiation lead SNPs had KU/KUF P < 0.05; ",
        "the filtered figure was not created.\n",
        sep = ""
      )

    } else {

      make_saunders_plot(
        plot_dat = plot_dat_p05,
        x_beta = x_beta,
        y_beta = y_beta,
        x_p = x_p,
        khat_trait = khat_trait,
        khat_n_label = khat_n_label,
        trait_label = trait_label,
        saunders_label = saunders_label,
        saunders_n_label = saunders_n_label,
        saunders_se_source = saunders_se_source,
        filter_label = "with P < 0.05"
      )
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Walters input files

for (file in files) {

  cat("\nProcessing:", basename(file), "\n")


  dat <- read.table(
    file,
    header = TRUE,

    check.names = FALSE,

  # Identify required KU/KUF and Walters beta columns

  x_p <- grep(
    "^p_ku$|^p_kuf$",
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE

  cat(
    "x_beta:",
    paste(x_beta, collapse = ", "),
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "y_beta:",
    paste(y_beta, collapse = ", "),
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "x_p:",
    paste(x_p, collapse = ", "),
    "\n"
  )


  if (
    length(x_beta) != 1 ||
      length(y_beta) != 1 ||
      length(x_p) != 1 ||
      !("khat_marker" %in% names(dat))
  ) {

    cat(
      "Skipping because required columns were not identified.\n"
    )

    print(names(dat))
    next
  }


  # Identify Walters p-value column.
  
  # Prefer an exact P column when present.
  # Otherwise search common p-value column names and
  # exclude the KU/KUF p-value column.
  if ("P" %in% names(dat)) {

    y_p <- "P"

  } else {

    y_p_candidates <- grep(
      "^p$|^pval$|^p_value$|^pvalue$|pval|p_value|pvalue",
      names(dat),
      value = TRUE,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )

    y_p_candidates <- setdiff(
      y_p_candidates,
      x_p
    )

    if (length(y_p_candidates) >= 1) {

      y_p <- y_p_candidates[1]

    } else {

      y_p <- character(0)
    }
  }


  # Search for a reported Walters SE column.
  
  # Exclude any SE column that appears to belong to KU/KUF.
  y_se_candidates <- grep(
    "^SE$|^se$|stderr|std_err|standard_error",
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  y_se_candidates <- y_se_candidates[
    !grepl(
      "ku|kuf|khat",
      y_se_candidates,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ]


  cat(
    "Walters p-value candidate:",
    paste(y_p, collapse = ", "),
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "Walters SE candidates:",
    paste(y_se_candidates, collapse = ", "),
    "\n"
  )


  # Convert required columns to numeric
  dat[[x_beta]] <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(dat[[x_beta]])
  )

  dat[[y_beta]] <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(dat[[y_beta]])
  )

  dat[[x_p]] <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(dat[[x_p]])
  )

  dat$khat_marker <- as.character(
    dat$khat_marker
  )


  # Identify Walters marker column
  marker_candidates <- grep(
    "marker$|^SNP$|^rsid$|^RSID$",
    names(dat),
    value = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  marker_candidates <- setdiff(
    marker_candidates,
    "khat_marker"
  )


  if (length(marker_candidates) > 0) {

    walters_marker <- marker_candidates[1]

    dat[[walters_marker]] <- as.character(
      dat[[walters_marker]]
    )

    cat(
      "Walters marker column:",
      walters_marker,
      "\n"
    )

  } else {

    walters_marker <- NULL

    cat(
      "No separate Walters marker column detected; ",
      "using khat_marker only.\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  }


  # Keep only Walters lead SNPs
  if (!is.null(walters_marker)) {

    dat_lead <- dat[
      dat$khat_marker %in% walters_lead |
        dat[[walters_marker]] %in% walters_lead,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

  } else {

    dat_lead <- dat[
      dat$khat_marker %in% walters_lead,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  }


  cat(
    "Requested Walters lead SNPs:",
    length(walters_lead),
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "Lead SNP rows found:",
    nrow(dat_lead),
    "\n"
  )


  # Identify found and missing lead SNPs
  found_leads <- dat_lead$khat_marker[
    dat_lead$khat_marker %in% walters_lead
  ]


  if (!is.null(walters_marker)) {

    found_leads <- c(
      found_leads,
      dat_lead[[walters_marker]][
        dat_lead[[walters_marker]] %in% walters_lead
      ]
    )
  }


  found_leads <- unique(
    found_leads[
      !is.na(found_leads) &
        found_leads != ""
    ]
  )

  missing_leads <- setdiff(
    walters_lead,
    found_leads
  )


  cat(
    "Lead SNPs found:",
    if (length(found_leads) > 0) {
      paste(found_leads, collapse = ", ")
    } else {
      "none"
    },
    "\n"
  )


  if (length(missing_leads) > 0) {

    cat(
      "Lead SNPs missing:",
      paste(missing_leads, collapse = ", "),
      "\n"
    )
  }


  # Keep rows with both beta estimates.
  
  # A valid KU/KUF p-value will be required later to
  # reconstruct the KU/KUF standard error.
  dat_lead <- dat_lead[
    !is.na(dat_lead[[x_beta]]) &
      !is.na(dat_lead[[y_beta]]) &
      is.finite(dat_lead[[x_beta]]) &
      is.finite(dat_lead[[y_beta]]),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  if (nrow(dat_lead) == 0) {

    cat(
      "Skipping because no complete Walters lead SNPs were found.\n"
    )

    next
  }



  # Reconstruct signed KU/KUF Z-score and standard error
  #
  # Z  = sign(beta) * |Phi^(-1)(p / 2)|
  # SE = beta / Z

  dat_lead$z_khat <- ifelse(
    !is.na(dat_lead[[x_beta]]) &
      is.finite(dat_lead[[x_beta]]) &
      !is.na(dat_lead[[x_p]]) &
      is.finite(dat_lead[[x_p]]) &
      dat_lead[[x_p]] > 0 &
      dat_lead[[x_p]] < 1 &
      dat_lead[[x_beta]] != 0,

    sign(dat_lead[[x_beta]]) *
      abs(qnorm(dat_lead[[x_p]] / 2)),

    NA_real_
  )


  dat_lead$se_khat <- ifelse(
    !is.na(dat_lead$z_khat) &
      is.finite(dat_lead$z_khat) &
      dat_lead$z_khat != 0,

    dat_lead[[x_beta]] /
      dat_lead$z_khat,

    NA_real_
  )



  # Obtain Walters standard errors

 
  # Prefer a reported Walters SE column when exactly one
  # suitable column is available.
  
  # Otherwise reconstruct the Walters SE from the Walters
  # beta and two-sided p-value.

  if (length(y_se_candidates) == 1) {

    y_se <- y_se_candidates[1]

    dat_lead[[y_se]] <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(dat_lead[[y_se]])
    )

    dat_lead$se_walters <- abs(
      dat_lead[[y_se]]
    )

    walters_se_source <- paste0(
      "reported SE column ",
      y_se
    )

  } else if (length(y_p) == 1) {

    dat_lead[[y_p]] <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(dat_lead[[y_p]])
    )


    dat_lead$z_walters <- ifelse(
      !is.na(dat_lead[[y_beta]]) &
        is.finite(dat_lead[[y_beta]]) &
        !is.na(dat_lead[[y_p]]) &
        is.finite(dat_lead[[y_p]]) &
        dat_lead[[y_p]] > 0 &
        dat_lead[[y_p]] < 1 &
        dat_lead[[y_beta]] != 0,

      sign(dat_lead[[y_beta]]) *
        abs(qnorm(dat_lead[[y_p]] / 2)),

      NA_real_
    )


    dat_lead$se_walters <- ifelse(
      !is.na(dat_lead$z_walters) &
        is.finite(dat_lead$z_walters) &
        dat_lead$z_walters != 0,

      dat_lead[[y_beta]] /
        dat_lead$z_walters,

      NA_real_
    )

    walters_se_source <- paste0(
      "reconstructed from p-value column ",
      y_p
    )

  } else {

    dat_lead$se_walters <- NA_real_
    walters_se_source <- "unavailable"
  }


  cat(
    "Walters SE source:",
    walters_se_source,
    "\n"
  )


  # Keep variants with usable KU/KUF and Walters SE values
  dat_lead <- dat_lead[
    !is.na(dat_lead$se_khat) &
      !is.na(dat_lead$se_walters) &
      is.finite(dat_lead$se_khat) &
      is.finite(dat_lead$se_walters) &
      dat_lead$se_khat >= 0 &
      dat_lead$se_walters >= 0,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  cat(
    "Lead SNP rows with usable SEs:",
    nrow(dat_lead),
    "\n"
  )


  if (nrow(dat_lead) == 0) {

    cat(
      "Skipping because no Walters lead SNPs had usable ",
      "KU/KUF and Walters SE values.\n",
      sep = ""
    )

    next
  }


  # Orient KU/KUF beta positively.
  #
  # Flip both aligned beta estimates together.
  # Standard errors are not flipped.
  flip_rows <- dat_lead[[x_beta]] < 0


  cat(
    "Lead SNP rows flipped:",
    sum(flip_rows, na.rm = TRUE),
    "\n"
  )


  dat_lead[[x_beta]][flip_rows] <-
    -dat_lead[[x_beta]][flip_rows]

  dat_lead[[y_beta]][flip_rows] <-
    -dat_lead[[y_beta]][flip_rows]


  # Calculate 95% confidence intervals
  dat_lead$x_ci_lower <-
    dat_lead[[x_beta]] -
    1.96 * dat_lead$se_khat

  dat_lead$x_ci_upper <-
    dat_lead[[x_beta]] +
    1.96 * dat_lead$se_khat

  dat_lead$y_ci_lower <-
    dat_lead[[y_beta]] -
    1.96 * dat_lead$se_walters

  dat_lead$y_ci_upper <-
    dat_lead[[y_beta]] +
    1.96 * dat_lead$se_walters


  # Highlight KU/KUF P < 1e-5
  dat_lead$highlight <-
    !is.na(dat_lead[[x_p]]) &
      is.finite(dat_lead[[x_p]]) &
      dat_lead[[x_p]] < ku_sug_thresh


  # Create marker labels
  if (!is.null(walters_marker)) {

    dat_lead$plot_marker <- ifelse(
      !is.na(dat_lead[[walters_marker]]) &
        dat_lead[[walters_marker]] != "",
      dat_lead[[walters_marker]],
      dat_lead$khat_marker
    )

  } else {

    dat_lead$plot_marker <-
      dat_lead$khat_marker
  }


  plot_dat <- dat_lead


  cat(
    "Complete lead SNP rows plotted:",
    nrow(plot_dat),
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "Lead SNPs highlighted at P < ",
    ku_sug_thresh,
    ": ",
    sum(plot_dat$highlight, na.rm = TRUE),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  # Plot labels
  pair_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(
    basename(file)
  )


  if (grepl("^ku_", pair_name)) {

    khat_trait <- "Khat Use"
    khat_n_label <- "KU N = 33,210"

  } else {

    khat_trait <- "Khat Use Frequency"
    khat_n_label <- "KUF N = 25,869"
  }


  walters_label <- "Walters Alcohol Dependence"
  alcdep_n_label <- "ALCDep N = 52,848"



  # Count plotted variants with nominal KU/KUF association (P < 0.05)
  khat_p05_count <- sum(
    !is.na(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
      is.finite(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
      plot_dat[[x_p]] < 0.05
  )

  cat(
    khat_trait,
    " variants with P < 0.05:",
    khat_p05_count,
    "\n"
  )

  # Pearson correlation among all plotted lead SNPs
  if (
    nrow(plot_dat) >= 3 &&
      length(unique(plot_dat[[x_beta]])) >= 2 &&
      length(unique(plot_dat[[y_beta]])) >= 2
  ) {

    pearson_test <- cor.test(
      plot_dat[[x_beta]],
      plot_dat[[y_beta]],
      method = "pearson"
    )

    pearson_r <- unname(
      pearson_test$estimate
    )

    pearson_p <- pearson_test$p.value


    title_correlation <- paste0(
      " | r = ",
      round(
        pearson_r,
        4
      )
    )


    correlation_label <- paste0(
      "Pearson p = ",
      format.pval(
        pearson_p,
        digits = 3,
        eps = 1e-300
      )
    )

  } else {

    title_correlation <- ""


    correlation_label <- paste0(
      "Pearson correlation not calculated; ",
      nrow(plot_dat),
      " complete lead SNP",
      ifelse(
        nrow(plot_dat) == 1,
        "",
        "s"
      ),
      " available"
    )
  }


  # Create plot
  # Generalized Deming regression
  deming_results <- get_deming_results(
    plot_dat = plot_dat,
    x_beta = x_beta,
    y_beta = y_beta,
    x_se = "se_khat",
    y_se = "se_walters"
  )

  add_comparison_summary(
    plot_dat = plot_dat,
    x_beta = x_beta,
    y_beta = y_beta,
    x_p = x_p,
    khat_trait = khat_trait,
    comparison_label = walters_label,
    deming_results = deming_results
  )


  p <- ggplot(
    plot_dat,
    aes(
      x = .data[[x_beta]],
      y = .data[[y_beta]]
    )
  ) +

    # Horizontal KU/KUF 95% confidence intervals
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        xmin = x_ci_lower,
        xmax = x_ci_upper
      ),
      orientation = "y",
      width = 0,
      alpha = 0.4,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    # Vertical Walters 95% confidence intervals
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = y_ci_lower,
        ymax = y_ci_upper
      ),
      width = 0,
      alpha = 0.4,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    # Plot every available Walters lead SNP
    geom_point(
      alpha = 0.6,
      size = 3
    ) +

    # Ordinary least-squares line of best fit
    {
      if (
        nrow(plot_dat) >= 2 &&
          length(unique(plot_dat[[x_beta]])) >= 2
      ) {

        geom_smooth(
          method = "lm",
          formula = y ~ x,
          se = FALSE,
          color = "blue",
          linetype = "dashed",
          linewidth = 0.8
        )
      }
    } +

    # Generalized Deming regression line
    {
      if (
        is.finite(deming_results$intercept) &&
          is.finite(deming_results$slope)
      ) {

        geom_abline(
          intercept = deming_results$intercept,
          slope = deming_results$slope,
          color = "blue",
          linetype = "solid",
          linewidth = 0.8
        )
      }
    } +

    # Highlight KU/KUF P < 1e-5
    geom_point(
      data = subset(
        plot_dat,
        highlight
      ),
      color = "red",
      size = 3.5
    ) +

    # Label only highlighted SNPs
    geom_text_repel(
      data = subset(
        plot_dat,
        highlight
      ),
      aes(
        label = plot_marker
      ),
      color = "red",
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.3,
      point.padding = 0.2
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0
    ) +

    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0
    ) +

    theme_bw() +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 10
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 5.5
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "NGAP: ",
        khat_trait,
        " x ",
        walters_label,
        " Lead SNPs",
        title_correlation
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        khat_n_label,
        " | ",
        alcdep_n_label,
        " | Lead SNPs plotted = ",
        nrow(plot_dat),
        " | Error bars = 95% CIs",
        " | ",
        deming_results$label,
        " | ",
        correlation_label
      ),
      x = paste0(
        khat_trait,
        " beta"
      ),
      y = paste0(
        walters_label,
        " beta"
      )
    )


  print(p)
}
```

```{r}

# Bright CanLU: setup and prepare lead-SNP datasets


data_dir <- "/Users/nico/work/sud/bright_harmonized"

ku_sug_thresh <- 1e-5

files <- list.files(
  path = data_dir,
  pattern = paste0(
    "^(ku|kuf)_canlu_",
    "(eur|cross_ancestry)_harmonized\\.txt$"
  ),
  full.names = TRUE
)

cat("Bright files found:", length(files), "\n")
print(basename(files))


# EUR meta-analysis lead SNPs
bright_eur_lead <- c(
  "rs858931",
  "rs1446710",
  "rs7609594",
  "rs861001",
  "rs16867990",
  "rs4712084",
  "rs10883796",
  "rs9919557",
  "rs2106480",
  "rs1788783",
  "rs2045154"
)


# Cross-ancestry meta-analysis lead SNPs
bright_cross_lead <- c(
  "rs10754807",
  "rs11902472",
  "rs1821351",
  "rs9858134",
  "rs1604060",
  "rs3095075",
  "rs112738674",
  "rs9357822",
  "rs2402870",
  "rs10883796",
  "rs10891480",
  "rs74644204",
  "rs62034323",
  "rs4925114",
  "rs1623003"
)


bright_eur_data <- list()
bright_cross_data <- list()


for (file in files) {

  cat("\nProcessing:", basename(file), "\n")

  dat <- read.table(
    file,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    fill = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )



  # KU versus KUF


  if (grepl("^ku_", basename(file))) {

    khat_beta <- "beta_ku"
    khat_p <- "p_ku"
    khat_trait <- "Khat Use"

  } else {

    khat_beta <- "beta_kuf"
    khat_p <- "p_kuf"
    khat_trait <- "Khat Use Frequency"
  }


  dat[[khat_beta]] <- as.numeric(
    dat[[khat_beta]]
  )

  dat[[khat_p]] <- as.numeric(
    dat[[khat_p]]
  )



  # Reconstruct signed KU/KUF Z-score
  #
  # Z = sign(beta) * |qnorm(P / 2)|


  dat$z_khat <- ifelse(
    !is.na(dat[[khat_beta]]) &
      is.finite(dat[[khat_beta]]) &
      !is.na(dat[[khat_p]]) &
      is.finite(dat[[khat_p]]) &
      dat[[khat_p]] > 0 &
      dat[[khat_p]] < 1 &
      dat[[khat_beta]] != 0,

    sign(dat[[khat_beta]]) *
      abs(qnorm(dat[[khat_p]] / 2)),

    NA_real_
  )



  # Reconstruct KU/KUF SE
  #
  # SE = beta / Z


  dat$se_khat <- ifelse(
    !is.na(dat$z_khat) &
      is.finite(dat$z_khat) &
      dat$z_khat != 0,

    dat[[khat_beta]] /
      dat$z_khat,

    NA_real_
  )



  # EUR meta-analysis


  if (grepl(
    "canlu_eur_harmonized",
    basename(file)
  )) {

    dat_lead <- dat[
      dat$khat_marker %in% bright_eur_lead |
        dat$rsid %in% bright_eur_lead,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]


    cat(
      "EUR lead SNP rows found:",
      nrow(dat_lead),
      "\n"
    )


    if (nrow(dat_lead) == 0) {
      next
    }


    dat_lead$beta_canlu_to_khat_A1 <-
      as.numeric(
        dat_lead$beta_canlu_to_khat_A1
      )

    dat_lead$canlu_SE <-
      as.numeric(
        dat_lead$canlu_SE
      )

    dat_lead$canlu_P <-
      as.numeric(
        dat_lead$canlu_P
      )


    dat_lead$plot_marker <- ifelse(
      !is.na(dat_lead$rsid) &
        dat_lead$rsid != "",
      dat_lead$rsid,
      dat_lead$khat_marker
    )


    attr(dat_lead, "x_beta") <- khat_beta
    attr(dat_lead, "x_p") <- khat_p
    attr(dat_lead, "khat_trait") <- khat_trait


    pair_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(
      basename(file)
    )

    bright_eur_data[[pair_name]] <- dat_lead
  }


  # Cross-ancestry meta-analysis
 

  if (grepl(
    "canlu_cross_ancestry_harmonized",
    basename(file)
  )) {

    dat_lead <- dat[
      dat$khat_marker %in% bright_cross_lead |
        dat$rsid %in% bright_cross_lead,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]


    cat(
      "Cross-ancestry lead SNP rows found:",
      nrow(dat_lead),
      "\n"
    )


    if (nrow(dat_lead) == 0) {
      next
    }


    dat_lead$z_canlu_to_khat_A1 <-
      as.numeric(
        dat_lead$z_canlu_to_khat_A1
      )

    dat_lead$canlu_P <-
      as.numeric(
        dat_lead$canlu_P
      )


    dat_lead$plot_marker <- ifelse(
      !is.na(dat_lead$rsid) &
        dat_lead$rsid != "",
      dat_lead$rsid,
      dat_lead$khat_marker
    )


    attr(dat_lead, "x_beta") <- khat_beta
    attr(dat_lead, "x_p") <- khat_p
    attr(dat_lead, "khat_trait") <- khat_trait


    pair_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(
      basename(file)
    )

    bright_cross_data[[pair_name]] <- dat_lead
  }
}


cat(
  "\nEUR datasets prepared:",
  length(bright_eur_data),
  "\n"
)

print(names(bright_eur_data))

cat(
  "\nCross-ancestry datasets prepared:",
  length(bright_cross_data),
  "\n"
)

print(names(bright_cross_data))
```

```{r}
# Bright CanLU EUR meta-analysis lead-SNP beta comparisons


for (pair_name in names(bright_eur_data)) {

  cat("\nPlotting:", pair_name, "\n")

  plot_dat <- bright_eur_data[[pair_name]]

  x_beta <- attr(
    plot_dat,
    "x_beta"
  )

  x_p <- attr(
    plot_dat,
    "x_p"
  )

  khat_trait <- attr(
    plot_dat,
    "khat_trait"
  )

  y_beta <- "beta_canlu_to_khat_A1"



  # Labels

  if (grepl("^ku_", pair_name)) {

    khat_n_label <- "KU N = 33,210"

  } else {

    khat_n_label <- "KUF N = 25,869"
  }

  canlu_n_label <- "CanLU EUR effective N = 258,823"



  # Keep complete beta + SE rows

  plot_dat <- plot_dat[
    !is.na(plot_dat[[x_beta]]) &
      !is.na(plot_dat[[y_beta]]) &
      !is.na(plot_dat$se_khat) &
      !is.na(plot_dat$canlu_SE) &
      is.finite(plot_dat[[x_beta]]) &
      is.finite(plot_dat[[y_beta]]) &
      is.finite(plot_dat$se_khat) &
      is.finite(plot_dat$canlu_SE) &
      plot_dat$se_khat > 0 &
      plot_dat$canlu_SE > 0,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  cat(
    "Complete Bright EUR lead SNPs:",
    nrow(plot_dat),
    "\n"
  )


  if (nrow(plot_dat) == 0) {

    cat(
      "No complete EUR variants; skipping.\n"
    )

    next
  }



  # Orient KU/KUF beta positively
  #
  # Both beta estimates are already oriented to khat_A1.


  flip_rows <- plot_dat[[x_beta]] < 0

  plot_dat[[x_beta]][flip_rows] <-
    -plot_dat[[x_beta]][flip_rows]

  plot_dat[[y_beta]][flip_rows] <-
    -plot_dat[[y_beta]][flip_rows]



  # 95% confidence intervals

  plot_dat$x_ci_lower <-
    plot_dat[[x_beta]] -
    1.96 * plot_dat$se_khat

  plot_dat$x_ci_upper <-
    plot_dat[[x_beta]] +
    1.96 * plot_dat$se_khat


  plot_dat$y_ci_lower <-
    plot_dat[[y_beta]] -
    1.96 * plot_dat$canlu_SE

  plot_dat$y_ci_upper <-
    plot_dat[[y_beta]] +
    1.96 * plot_dat$canlu_SE



  # Highlight Khat P < 1e-5


  plot_dat$highlight <-
    !is.na(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
    is.finite(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
    plot_dat[[x_p]] < ku_sug_thresh



  # Pearson correlation


  if (
    nrow(plot_dat) >= 3 &&
      length(unique(plot_dat[[x_beta]])) >= 2 &&
      length(unique(plot_dat[[y_beta]])) >= 2
  ) {

    pearson_test <- cor.test(
      plot_dat[[x_beta]],
      plot_dat[[y_beta]],
      method = "pearson"
    )

    pearson_r <- unname(
      pearson_test$estimate
    )

    pearson_p <- pearson_test$p.value


    title_correlation <- paste0(
      " | r = ",
      round(pearson_r, 4)
    )

    correlation_label <- paste0(
      "Pearson p = ",
      format.pval(
        pearson_p,
        digits = 3,
        eps = 1e-300
      )
    )

  } else {

    title_correlation <- ""

    correlation_label <- paste0(
      "Pearson correlation not calculated; ",
      nrow(plot_dat),
      " complete lead SNPs"
    )
  }


  # Generalized Deming regression


  deming_results <- get_deming_results(
    plot_dat = plot_dat,
    x_beta = x_beta,
    y_beta = y_beta,
    x_se = "se_khat",
    y_se = "canlu_SE"
  )


  # Add EUR comparison to existing summary table
  add_comparison_summary(
    plot_dat = plot_dat,
    x_beta = x_beta,
    y_beta = y_beta,
    x_p = x_p,
    khat_trait = khat_trait,
    comparison_label =
      "Bright CanLU European Meta-analysis",
    deming_results = deming_results
  )



  # Plot


  p <- ggplot(
    plot_dat,
    aes(
      x = .data[[x_beta]],
      y = .data[[y_beta]]
    )
  ) +

    # KU/KUF 95% CI
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        xmin = x_ci_lower,
        xmax = x_ci_upper
      ),
      orientation = "y",
      width = 0,
      alpha = 0.4,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    # CanLU 95% CI
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = y_ci_lower,
        ymax = y_ci_upper
      ),
      width = 0,
      alpha = 0.4,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    geom_point(
      alpha = 0.6,
      size = 3
    ) +

    # Ordinary least-squares line
    {
      if (
        nrow(plot_dat) >= 2 &&
          length(unique(plot_dat[[x_beta]])) >= 2
      ) {

        geom_smooth(
          method = "lm",
          formula = y ~ x,
          se = FALSE,
          color = "blue",
          linetype = "dashed",
          linewidth = 0.8
        )
      }
    } +

    # Deming regression line
    {
      if (
        is.finite(deming_results$intercept) &&
          is.finite(deming_results$slope)
      ) {

        geom_abline(
          intercept = deming_results$intercept,
          slope = deming_results$slope,
          color = "blue",
          linetype = "solid",
          linewidth = 0.8
        )
      }
    } +

    # Highlight Khat P < 1e-5
    geom_point(
      data = subset(
        plot_dat,
        highlight
      ),
      color = "red",
      size = 3.5
    ) +

    # Label highlighted SNPs only
    geom_text_repel(
      data = subset(
        plot_dat,
        highlight
      ),
      aes(
        label = plot_marker
      ),
      color = "red",
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.3,
      point.padding = 0.2
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0
    ) +

    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0
    ) +

    theme_bw() +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 10
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 6
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "NGAP: ",
        khat_trait,
        " x Bright CanLU European Meta-analysis Lead SNPs",
        title_correlation
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        khat_n_label,
        " | ",
        canlu_n_label,
        " | Lead SNPs plotted = ",
        nrow(plot_dat),
        " | Error bars = 95% CIs",
        " | ",
        deming_results$label,
        " | ",
        correlation_label
      ),
      x = paste0(
        khat_trait,
        " beta"
      ),
      y = "CanLU European meta-analysis beta"
    )

  print(p)
}
```




### Comparison summary table
```{r}
# Add Liu Smoking Initiation KU/KUF P < 0.05 comparisons
# to the end of comparison_summary

smkinit_names <- names(liu_lead_data)[
  grepl(
    "SmokingInitiation",
    names(liu_lead_data),
    fixed = TRUE
  )
]

for (pair_name in smkinit_names) {

  plot_dat <- liu_lead_data[[pair_name]]

  # Retrieve stored column names
  x_beta <- attr(plot_dat, "x_beta")
  x_p <- attr(plot_dat, "x_p")
  y_beta <- attr(plot_dat, "y_beta")

  # Identify KU versus KUF
  if (grepl("^ku_", pair_name)) {

    khat_trait <- "Khat Use"
    filter_label <- "KU pval < 0.05"

  } else {

    khat_trait <- "Khat Use Frequency"
    filter_label <- "KUF pval < 0.05"
  }

  # Keep the same complete rows used in the Liu plots,
  # additionally requiring KU/KUF P < 0.05
  plot_dat <- plot_dat[
    !is.na(plot_dat[[x_beta]]) &
      !is.na(plot_dat[[y_beta]]) &
      !is.na(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
      !is.na(plot_dat$se_khat) &
      !is.na(plot_dat$se_liu) &
      is.finite(plot_dat[[x_beta]]) &
      is.finite(plot_dat[[y_beta]]) &
      is.finite(plot_dat[[x_p]]) &
      is.finite(plot_dat$se_khat) &
      is.finite(plot_dat$se_liu) &
      plot_dat[[x_p]] > 0 &
      plot_dat[[x_p]] < 0.05 &
      plot_dat$se_khat >= 0 &
      plot_dat$se_liu >= 0,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (nrow(plot_dat) == 0) {
    next
  }

  # Use the same positive-KU/KUF orientation as the Liu plots
  flip_rows <- plot_dat[[x_beta]] < 0

  plot_dat[[x_beta]][flip_rows] <-
    -plot_dat[[x_beta]][flip_rows]

  plot_dat[[y_beta]][flip_rows] <-
    -plot_dat[[y_beta]][flip_rows]

  # Recalculate Deming regression for the filtered comparison
  deming_results <- get_deming_results(
    plot_dat = plot_dat,
    x_beta = x_beta,
    y_beta = y_beta,
    x_se = "se_khat",
    y_se = "se_liu"
  )

  # Append the filtered comparison row
  add_comparison_summary(
    plot_dat = plot_dat,
    x_beta = x_beta,
    y_beta = y_beta,
    x_p = x_p,
    khat_trait = khat_trait,
    comparison_label = paste0(
      "Liu Smoking Initiation | ",
      filter_label
    ),
    deming_results = deming_results
  )
}
```


```{r}
# Final table containing one row per primary comparison.
# For Liu Smoking Initiation, the summary uses all usable lead SNPs from the
# main Liu comparison cell, not the separate KU/KUF P < 0.05-only visualization.
# Therefore, "Number of Variants in Comparison" is the full usable denominator,
# while the final column is the subset with KU/KUF P < 0.05.
# Raw numeric values are retained in comparison_summary.
comparison_summary_display <- comparison_summary %>%
  mutate(
    `Pearson Correlation` = round(`Pearson Correlation`, 4),
    `Pearson Pvalue` = ifelse(
      is.na(`Pearson Pvalue`),
      NA_character_,
      format.pval(`Pearson Pvalue`, digits = 3, eps = 1e-300)
    ),
    `Deming Slope` = round(`Deming Slope`, 4),
    `Deming Pvalue` = ifelse(
      is.na(`Deming Pvalue`),
      NA_character_,
      format.pval(`Deming Pvalue`, digits = 3, eps = 1e-300)
    )
  )

# Print to the R console
print(comparison_summary_display)

# Render as a table in the knitted HTML document
knitr::kable(
  comparison_summary_display,
  align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
  caption = NULL
)
```
